title.zh: 卷349 列傳一百三十六 王文雄 朱射鬥 穆克登布 富成 施缙 袁国璜 惠伦等
title.en: Volume 349 Biographies 136: Wang Wenxiong, Zhu Shedou, Mu Kedengbu, Fu Cheng, Shi Jin, Yuan Guohuang, Hui Lundeng
title.raw: 卷349 列傳一百三十六 王文雄 朱射鬥 穆克登布 富成 施缙 袁国璜 惠伦等

sentences.zh: 德齡保興凝德多爾濟扎布王凱王懋賞

translations.literal: Delinge, Baoxing, Ningde, Duoerji Zhabu, Wang Kai, and Wang Maoshang.
translations.idiomatic: Delinge, Baoxing, Ningde, Duoerji Zhabu, Wang Kai, and Wang Maoshang.

sentences.zh: 惠倫安祿佛住西津泰豐伸布阿爾薩朗烏什哈達和興額}}王文雄，字叔師，貴州玉屏人。

translations.literal: Hui Lun, An Lufo, Zhu Xijin, Taifeng, Shenbu, Ersang, Wushihada, and Hexinge. Wang Wenxiong, style name Shushi, was a native of Yuping in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Also treated in this chapter are Hui Lun, An Lufo, Zhu Xijin, Taifeng, Shenbu, Ersang, Wushihada, and Hexinge. Wang Wenxiong, whose style was Shushi, came from Yuping in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 由行伍從征緬甸、金川，擢至游擊，洊升直隸通州協副將。

translations.literal: Rising from the ranks, he campaigned in Burma and Jinchuan, was promoted to guerrilla colonel, and was repeatedly advanced to deputy commander of the Tongzhou Brigade in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through the ranks on the Burma and Jinchuan campaigns, attained the rank of guerrilla colonel, and was promoted in due course to deputy commander of the Tongzhou Brigade in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，調剿襄陽教匪，從慶成戰劉家集、梁家岡、張家垱，賜號法佛禮巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he was transferred to suppress the Xiangyang sect rebels; with Qing Cheng he fought at Liujiaji, Liangjiagang, and Zhangjiadang, and was granted the honorific title Fofuli Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 1 he was assigned to suppress the Xiangyang rebels. Fighting alongside Qing Cheng at Liujiaji, Liangjiagang, and Zhangjiadang, he was awarded the honorific name Fofuli Baturu.

sentences.zh: 秋，賊圍鍾祥，進擊破之，擢南陽鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In autumn the rebels besieged Zhongxiang; he advanced, defeated them, and was promoted to commander of the Nanyang Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, when rebels besieged Zhongxiang, he marched out, broke the siege, and was promoted to commander of the Nanyang Garrison.

sentences.zh: 冬，賊分竄河南，命率兵二千迴境防禦。

translations.literal: In winter the rebels scattered into Henan; he was ordered to lead two thousand men back to his jurisdiction to defend it.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, as the rebels scattered into Henan, he was ordered home with two thousand troops to defend his own territory.

sentences.zh: 二年春，敗賊禹山，又敗之鄭家河；

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year he defeated the rebels at Yushan and again at Zhengjiahe;
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Jiaqing 2 he routed the rebels at Yushan and again at Zhengjiahe;

sentences.zh: 追剿至裕州四里店，值他軍與賊戰，夾擊敗之。

translations.literal: pursuing them to Silidian in Yuzhou, where he found another army already engaged with the rebels and joined in a pincer attack that defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: pursued them as far as Silidian in Yuzhou, where he came upon another force already fighting the rebels and, attacking from both sides, drove them off.

sentences.zh: 夏，息縣奸民張雲路倡亂，馳剿即平。

translations.literal: In summer the rogue Zhang Yunlu of Xi County incited a revolt; Wenxiong galloped to suppress it and the disturbance was quickly pacified.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, when the troublemaker Zhang Yunlu of Xi County raised a local revolt, Wenxiong rode out at once and put it down.

sentences.zh: 秋，仍赴襄陽。

translations.literal: In autumn he returned once more to Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn he went back to Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 時姚之富等逼南漳，文雄駐軍五盤山，扼其衝，擊賊於白虎頭、峽口。

translations.literal: At that time Yao Zhifu and others pressed toward Nanzhang; Wenxiong encamped on Wupanshan, blocked their line of advance, and attacked the rebels at Baihutou and Xiakou.
translations.idiomatic: When Yao Zhifu and his band threatened Nanzhang, Wenxiong took position on Wupanshan, seized the choke point, and struck the rebels at Baihutou and Xiakou.

sentences.zh: 聞賊竄陸坪，分兵擊之，追至羊角山，斬其渠。

translations.literal: Learning that the rebels had fled to Luping, he detached troops to strike them, pursued them to Yangjiaoshan, and beheaded their leader.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing that the rebels had slipped away to Luping, he sent detachments after them, ran them down at Yangjiaoshan, and killed their chieftain.

sentences.zh: 賊乃以數百人綴官軍，潛趨南漳城，文雄伏兵百步梯，火之，賊多墜崖死，遂赴陝西、河南界禦賊，且防興安江岸。

translations.literal: The rebels then used several hundred men to delay the government troops while secretly hurrying toward Nanzhang city; Wenxiong ambushed them at Baibuti, set fire to them, and many rebels fell from the cliffs and died. He then went to the Shaanxi–Henan border to resist the rebels and also guard the banks of the Xing'an River.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels left a few hundred men to slow the government force while stealing toward Nanzhang. Wenxiong lay in wait at Baibuti, set the place ablaze, and many rebels plunged from the cliffs to their deaths. He then moved to the Shaanxi–Henan frontier to hold the rebels at bay and guard the Xing'an River line.

sentences.zh: 三年春，高均德自寧羌渡漢，齊王氏、姚之富乘官軍往剿，偕李全自西鄉、洋縣分道踵渡，掠郿縣、盩厔，西安戒嚴。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year Gao Junde crossed the Han from Ningqiang; Qi Wangshi and Yao Zhifu, while government troops were away on campaign, followed with Li Quan, crossing in separate columns from Xixiang and Yang County, plundered Mei County and Zhiyang, and Xi'an was placed under martial alert.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Jiaqing 3, Gao Junde crossed the Han from Ningqiang. Qi Wangshi and Yao Zhifu took advantage of the army's absence to follow with Li Quan, fording the river in separate columns from Xixiang and Yang County, raiding Mei and Zhiyang and throwing Xi'an into a state of alarm.

sentences.zh: 文雄馳援，敗賊焦家鎮，追至屹子村，猝遇賊萬餘。

translations.literal: Wenxiong rushed to the relief, defeated the rebels at Jiaojiazhen, pursued them to Yizicun, and suddenly encountered more than ten thousand rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Wenxiong galloped to the rescue, routed the rebels at Jiaojiazhen, and pursued them to Yizicun, where he suddenly ran into a rebel force of more than ten thousand.

sentences.zh: 文雄兵不滿二千，張兩翼待。

translations.literal: Wenxiong had fewer than two thousand men; he deployed both wings and waited.
translations.idiomatic: Wenxiong had fewer than two thousand men under him. He spread his wings and held his ground.

sentences.zh: 賊亦分左右來犯，為火器擊退；

translations.literal: The rebels likewise divided into left and right columns to attack and were driven back by firearms;
translations.idiomatic: The rebels likewise split and came at him from both flanks, only to be beaten back by gunfire;

sentences.zh: 復分四路至，又敗之，遂悉馬步圍官軍數重，文雄為圓陣外向，賊以千餘騎猛撲，令藤牌兵大呼躍出，賊馬驚，返奔，追殺數千人，斃其黨王士奇。

translations.literal: they then came by four routes and were defeated again; then all their cavalry and infantry surrounded the government army in several rings. Wenxiong formed a circular formation facing outward; the rebels charged fiercely with more than a thousand horsemen, and he ordered the rattan-shield troops to leap out with loud shouts; the rebel horses panicked and fled back, and in the pursuit several thousand were killed, including the rebel Wang Shiqi.
translations.idiomatic: they came on again by four roads and were beaten once more. Then the rebels threw all their horse and foot around the government force in ring after ring. Wenxiong formed a circle facing outward. When more than a thousand horsemen charged headlong, he sent his rattan-shield men leaping forward with a great shout. The rebel mounts panicked and wheeled about; the pursuit left several thousand dead, including the rebel Wang Shiqi.

sentences.zh: 自是賊不敢北犯，省城獲安。

translations.literal: From then on the rebels did not dare raid northward, and the provincial capital was secured.
translations.idiomatic: After that the rebels no longer dared strike north, and the provincial capital was safe.

sentences.zh: 詔以文雄當數倍之賊，五戰，所殺過當，深嘉之，立擢固原提督。

translations.literal: An edict praised Wenxiong for facing rebels several times his strength, fighting five engagements, and killing more than his due share; he was deeply commended and immediately promoted to provincial commander of Guyuan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised Wenxiong for standing against a foe many times his strength, fighting five battles, and inflicting losses far beyond what might have been expected. The court was deeply pleased and promoted him at once to provincial commander of Guyuan.

sentences.zh: 追敗賊於尹家衝，其分竄翔峪、澧峪者盡殲焉。

translations.literal: He pursued and defeated the rebels at Yinjiachong, and those who had scattered into Xiangyu and Liyu were entirely annihilated.
translations.idiomatic: He pursued the rebels to Yinjiachong and routed them, and the bands that had scattered into Xiangyu and Liyu were wiped out to the last.

sentences.zh: 夏，敗高均德於盩厔，又敗阮正通於南鄭。

translations.literal: In summer he defeated Gao Junde at Zhiyang and also defeated Ruan Zhengtong at Nanzheng.
translations.idiomatic: That summer he beat Gao Junde at Zhiyang and Ruan Zhengtong at Nanzheng.

sentences.zh: 秋，張漢潮由南鄭東南竄，文雄冒雨疾馳兩晝夜，追及於廉水戺，賊踞山，以砲仰擊之，乃分馬步隊潛來鈔截，三路迎擊，斃賊千餘。

translations.literal: In autumn Zhang Hanchao fled southeast from Nanzheng; Wenxiong rode through rain for two days and nights, overtook him at Lianshui, the rebels holding the heights; he fired upward with cannon, then divided cavalry and infantry to come secretly and cut them off, met them on three roads, and killed more than a thousand rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, when Zhang Hanchao broke southeast from Nanzheng, Wenxiong drove through the rain for two days and nights and caught him at Lianshui. The rebels held the heights; he shelled them from below, then sent horse and foot in secret to cut around behind them. Attacking on three roads, he left more than a thousand rebels dead.

sentences.zh: 正通竄西鄉西流河，而設伏於銅廠山梁，文雄分兵破其伏，自攻中堅，擒張金等。

translations.literal: Zhengtong fled to Xiliuhe in Xixiang while setting an ambush on the ridge at Tongchangshan; Wenxiong detached troops to break the ambush and himself attacked the center, capturing Zhang Jin and others.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong fled toward Xiliuhe in Xixiang but laid an ambush on the Tongchangshan ridge. Wenxiong sent detachments to break the trap and led the assault on the center himself, taking Zhang Jin and others prisoner.

sentences.zh: 四年，命與恆瑞分領總督宜綿所部兵，專剿陝境竄匪。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was ordered, with Heng Rui, to divide command of the troops under Governor-General Yi Mian and devote themselves solely to suppressing the rebels raiding within Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 4 he and Heng Rui were ordered to divide command of Governor-General Yi Mian's forces and concentrate exclusively on the rebels operating inside Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 秋，敗苟文明於倒水洞，連敗冉天元於沙田壩、景山坪、皮貨舖，川賊龍紹週竄池壩，欲應天元，扼之貫子山。

translations.literal: In autumn he defeated Gou Wenming at Daoshuidong and repeatedly defeated Ran Tianyuan at Shatianba, Jingshanping, and Pihuopu; the Sichuan rebel Long Shaozhou fled to Yanchiba intending to join Tianyuan, and Wenxiong blocked him at Guanzishan.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he routed Gou Wenming at Daoshuidong and beat Ran Tianyuan again and again at Shatianba, Jingshanping, and Pihuopu. When the Sichuan rebel Long Shaozhou slipped into Yanchiba to link up with Tianyuan, Wenxiong intercepted him at Guanzishan.

sentences.zh: 別賊冒齊家營者來犯，悉殲之。

translations.literal: Another band, posing as men of the Qi family camp, came to attack and was entirely wiped out.
translations.idiomatic: Another band pretending to be from the Qi family camp attacked and was annihilated to a man.

sentences.zh: 黃號伍義蘭、藍號曾六兒踞老鷹崖，分兵進擊，擒其黨李智花等，餘賊遁入川。

translations.literal: Wu Yilan of the Yellow Banner and Zeng Liu'er of the Blue Banner held Laoyingya; he divided his forces to attack, captured their followers Li Zhihua and others, and the remaining rebels fled into Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Yilan of the Yellow faction and Zeng Liu'er of the Blue faction held Laoyingya. Wenxiong attacked in divided columns, seized Li Zhihua and other lieutenants, and the rest of the rebels escaped into Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 冬，樊人傑、唐大信竄西鄉。

translations.literal: In winter Fan Renjie and Tang Daxin raided into Xixiang.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Fan Renjie and Tang Daxin broke into Xixiang.

sentences.zh: 文雄積勞嘔血，力疾督戰，溫詔慰勞。

translations.literal: Wenxiong, worn out by accumulated labor, vomited blood, yet forced himself while ill to direct the fighting; a warm edict comforted and rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: Worn down by years of campaigning, Wenxiong was coughing blood, yet he dragged himself from his sickbed to command the fighting. The throne sent a warm edict of praise and consolation.

sentences.zh: 尋，黃號諸賊復自川入陝，令游擊梁煥擊之，遇伏幾殆，馳救，解其圍。

translations.literal: Soon afterward the Yellow Banner rebels again entered Shaanxi from Sichuan; he ordered Guerrilla Colonel Liang Huan to attack them. Huan fell into an ambush and was nearly destroyed; Wenxiong galloped to the rescue and lifted the siege.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Yellow-faction rebels crossed back from Sichuan into Shaanxi. Wenxiong sent Guerrilla Colonel Liang Huan against them, but Huan walked into an ambush and was nearly wiped out. Wenxiong rode to his relief and broke the encirclement.

sentences.zh: 疾復作，而賊之匿老林者，潛出犯南鄭、沔縣、略陽，欲渡嘉陵江，詔斥疏防，當治罪，以病原之。

translations.literal: His illness returned, and rebels hiding in the old forests slipped out to raid Nanzheng, Mian County, and Lueyang, intending to cross the Jialing River. An edict rebuked the lax defense and said he should be punished, but his illness was taken as the cause.
translations.idiomatic: His illness flared again just as rebels who had been hiding in the deep forests slipped out against Nanzheng, Mian, and Lueyang, aiming to cross the Jialing. An edict rebuked the lapse in defense and called for punishment, but in the end his sickness was accepted as the explanation.

sentences.zh: 五年夏，敗楊開甲於土門關。

translations.literal: In the summer of the fifth year he defeated Yang Kaijia at Tumen Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of Jiaqing 5 he routed Yang Kaijia at Tumen Pass.

sentences.zh: 唐大信踞西鄉節草壩、大祥壩，夜襲克之。

translations.literal: Tang Daxin held Jiecao Dam and Daxiang Dam in Xixiang; Wenxiong took them in a night assault.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Daxin held Jiecao Dam and Daxiang Dam in Xixiang; Wenxiong stormed both positions in a night attack.

sentences.zh: 龍紹週與大信合，敗之魏家寨，又連敗之黑山萬曲灣、火石埡、山王廟，賊遁入川。

translations.literal: Long Shaozhou joined Daxin; Wenxiong defeated them at Weijiazhai and again and again at Heishan, Wanquwan, Huoshiya, and Shanwangmiao, and the rebels fled into Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Long Shaozhou joined forces with Daxin, but Wenxiong beat them at Weijiazhai and again at Heishan, Wanquwan, Huoshiya, and Shanwangmiao until the rebels fled back into Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 未幾，高天德、馬學禮及戴家營賊竄西鄉堰口，窺縣城，迎擊敗之。

translations.literal: Before long Gao Tiande, Ma Xueli, and the Dai family camp rebels raided to Yankou in Xixiang, watching for a chance at the county seat; he met them and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Gao Tiande, Ma Xueli, and the Dai family camp rebels slipped to Yankou in Xixiang and eyed the county town. Wenxiong met them head-on and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 偵賊眾潛屯法寶山，夜偕副將鮑貴等分三路進，賊擲石以拒，文雄督眾仰攻，突有騎賊從溝中出，截其後，山上賊出間道撲鮑貴隊，急趨救，賊乘勢悉眾下山，鏖戰至午，圍益急，文雄被創十餘，猶力鬥，左臂斷，墜馬，伏地北向呼曰：「不能仰報君恩矣！

translations.literal: Scouts reported that a large rebel force was secretly encamped on Fabao Mountain; at night, with Deputy Commander Bao Gui and others, he advanced in three columns. The rebels hurled stones to resist; Wenxiong directed the troops in an uphill assault. Suddenly mounted rebels emerged from a ravine and cut off his rear; rebels on the mountain came by a hidden path and fell upon Bao Gui's detachment. He hurried to the rescue; the rebels took advantage and brought all their forces down the hill. The fierce fighting lasted until noon, the encirclement tightening. Wenxiong received more than ten wounds yet still fought on; his left arm was severed, he fell from his horse, prostrated himself facing north, and cried, "I can no longer repay the grace of the sovereign!"
translations.idiomatic: Intelligence placed a large rebel force in secret camp on Fabao Mountain. At night Wenxiong advanced in three columns with Deputy Commander Bao Gui and others. The rebels hurled stones down on them as Wenxiong led the uphill assault. Suddenly horsemen burst from a ravine behind him, while rebels on the heights swept down a hidden path onto Bao Gui's detachment. Wenxiong rushed to save them; the rebels poured their whole strength down the slope. The battle raged until noon and the ring closed tighter. He took more than a dozen wounds yet kept fighting until his left arm was struck off, he was thrown from his horse, and prostrate, facing north, he cried, "I can no longer repay my sovereign's grace!"

sentences.zh: 」遂卒。

translations.literal: " and thereupon died.
translations.idiomatic: " With that he died.

sentences.zh: 仁宗震悼，封三等子爵，祀昭忠祠，諡壯節，諭慰其母，賜銀千兩。

translations.literal: The Renzong Emperor was deeply shaken and grieved; he enfeoffed Wenxiong as a third-rank viscount, enshrined him in the Shrine of Loyalty and Fidelity, gave him the posthumous title Zhuangjie, sent comforting instructions to his mother, and granted a thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Renzong was stricken with grief. He enfeoffed Wenxiong as a third-rank viscount, had him honored in the Shrine of Loyalty and Fidelity, gave him the posthumous title Zhuangjie, sent words of comfort to his mother, and granted a thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 逾年，獲戕文雄之賊馬應祥，命傳首就其家致祭。

translations.literal: The following year the rebel Ma Yingxiang, who had killed Wenxiong, was captured; the court ordered his head sent to Wenxiong's home for a memorial offering.
translations.idiomatic: A year later Ma Yingxiang, the rebel who had killed Wenxiong, was taken. The court ordered his head sent to Wenxiong's home for a memorial sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 子開雲，襲子爵，官至山東鹽運使。

translations.literal: His son Kaiyun inherited the viscountcy and rose to the post of salt transport commissioner of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: His son Kaiyun inherited the viscountcy and eventually rose to salt transport commissioner of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 硃射鬥，字文光，貴州貴築人。

translations.literal: Zhu Shedou, style name Wenguang, was a native of Guizhu in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Shedou, whose style was Wenguang, came from Guizhu in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 幼讀書。

translations.literal: In youth he studied books.
translations.idiomatic: As a boy he received a literary education.

sentences.zh: 入伍，從征緬甸、金川，功多，累擢至都司。

translations.literal: He entered military service, campaigned in Burma and Jinchuan with many achievements, and was repeatedly promoted to battalion commander.
translations.idiomatic: He enlisted, fought in Burma and Jinchuan with distinction, and was promoted in due course to battalion commander.

sentences.zh: 果毅善戰，為將軍阿桂所激賞，洊升貴州平遠協副將。

translations.literal: Resolute and skilled in battle, he was warmly admired by General Agui and was repeatedly promoted to deputy commander of the Pingyuan Brigade in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Bold and formidable in battle, he won the high regard of General Agui and rose to deputy commander of the Pingyuan Brigade in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十年，擢湖南鎮筸鎮總兵，調雲南普洱鎮，民、苗雜處，綏撫得宜，邊氓翕服。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year of Qianlong he was promoted to commander of the Zhenbian Garrison in Hunan, transferred to the Pu'er Garrison in Yunnan, where Han and Miao lived intermixed; he pacified and comforted them appropriately, and the border people submitted in harmony.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 50 he was made commander of the Zhenbian Garrison in Hunan, then transferred to the Pu'er Garrison in Yunnan, where Han and Miao lived side by side. He governed the region wisely, and the frontier people came quietly to heel.

sentences.zh: 從征廓爾喀，歷福建福寧鎮、四川川北鎮。

translations.literal: He followed the campaign against Gurkha and served successively at the Funing Garrison in Fujian and the Chuanbei Garrison in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: He took part in the Gurkha campaign and later held commands at the Funing Garrison in Fujian and the Chuanbei Garrison in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 苗疆事起，率本鎮兵赴剿，迭克險隘。

translations.literal: When trouble broke out in the Miao frontier, he led the troops of his garrison to suppress it and repeatedly captured strategic passes.
translations.idiomatic: When the Miao frontier rose in revolt, he led his garrison troops to suppress it and took one defile after another.

sentences.zh: 平隴之戰，潛師襲後山貫魚坡，賊乃潰。

translations.literal: In the battle of Pinglong he sent troops secretly to strike Guanyupo on the rear slope, and the rebels then collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: At Pinglong he sent a detachment in secret against Guanyupo on the rear slope, and the rebel line broke.

sentences.zh: 偕額勒登保攻石隆寨，伏溝下驀入，斷其要路，賊來爭，奮擊盡殲，遂斬賊魁石柳鄧，賜號幹勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: Together with Eledengbao he attacked Shilong Stockade; lying in ambush below a ditch, he suddenly burst in, cut their vital route, and when the rebels came to contest it he fought fiercely and annihilated them, then beheaded the rebel chieftain Shi Liudeng and was granted the honorific title Ganyong Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: With Eledengbao he attacked Shilong Stockade. Lying in wait below a ravine, he burst in without warning, severed the rebels' lifeline, and when they rushed to recover it he cut them down to the last man and beheaded their leader Shi Liudeng. He was awarded the honorific name Ganyong Baturu.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年春，凱撤回川北，王三槐踞金瓘寺，合攻克之，連破王家寨、茨茹梁、富成寨，要擊於黃家山，三槐中槍，墜馬跳免。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year of Jiaqing, after returning to north Sichuan, he joined forces to capture Jinguan Temple, where Wang Sanhuai was entrenched; they took it together, then in succession broke Wangjia Stockade, Ciruliang, and Fucheng Stockade, intercepted them at Huangjiashan, and Sanhuai was shot, fell from his horse, and escaped by leaping away.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Jiaqing 2, back in north Sichuan, he joined an assault on Jinguan Temple, where Wang Sanhuai had dug in. They took the place, then stormed Wangjia Stockade, Ciruliang, and Fucheng Stockade in succession. At Huangjiashan he intercepted the rebels; Sanhuai was shot, thrown from his horse, and fled on foot.

sentences.zh: 合攻重石子、香爐坪賊巢，擊秋波梁竄匪，殲之。

translations.literal: In a joint attack they took the rebel nests at Chongshizi and Xiangluping and struck the rebels who had fled to Qiuboliang, annihilating them.
translations.idiomatic: In a combined operation they stormed the rebel strongholds at Chongshizi and Xiangluping and wiped out the band that had slipped away to Qiuboliang.

sentences.zh: 偕總兵百祥攻羅其清、冉文儔於方山坪，敗走巴州。

translations.literal: With Commander Bai Xiang he attacked Luo Qiqing and Ran Wenchou at Fangshanping and drove them in defeat toward Bazhou.
translations.idiomatic: With Commander Bai Xiang he attacked Luo Qiqing and Ran Wenchou at Fangshanping and drove them in defeat toward Bazhou.

sentences.zh: 射鬥駐保寧，詔以本鎮轄地，責嚴守。

translations.literal: Shedou was stationed at Baoning; an edict charged him with the territory under his garrison's jurisdiction and ordered strict defense.
translations.idiomatic: Shedou was posted at Baoning. An edict made him responsible for his garrison district and ordered him to hold it firmly.

sentences.zh: 三槐撲天華山營，力戰卻之。

translations.literal: Sanhuai rushed the camp at Tianhuashan; Shedou fought fiercely and repulsed him.
translations.idiomatic: When Sanhuai threw himself at the Tianhuashan camp, Shedou fought him off in a hard engagement.

sentences.zh: 又合徐天德分撲風門鋪、角山、茶店，馳擊，賊遁走。

translations.literal: He again joined Xu Tiande in separate attacks on Fengmenpu, Jiaoshan, and Chadian, galloped to strike, and the rebels fled.
translations.idiomatic: He joined Xu Tiande in divided strikes on Fengmenpu, Jiaoshan, and Chadian, rode hard against the rebels, and put them to flight.

sentences.zh: 三年，其清竄儀隴雙路場，偕穆克登布追剿，斬七百餘級。

translations.literal: In the third year Qiqing fled to Shuangluchang in Yilong; with Mu Kedengbu he pursued and killed more than seven hundred.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 3, when Qiqing fled to Shuangluchang in Yilong, Shedou pursued him with Mu Kedengbu and took more than seven hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 其清等踞大鵬寨，諸軍合攻，射鬥與恆瑞當其北，賊冒雨突營，出其後夾擊，賊竄伏深溝，悉擒之。

translations.literal: Qiqing and others held Dapeng Stockade; the armies attacked together, Shedou and Heng Rui blocking the north. The rebels charged the camp in the rain; he came out behind them in a pincer attack; the rebels fled into a deep ravine and were all captured.
translations.idiomatic: Qiqing and his men held Dapeng Stockade. When the allied armies attacked, Shedou and Heng Rui blocked the north. The rebels charged the camp through the rain; Shedou struck from behind in a pincer, drove them into a deep ravine, and took them all.

sentences.zh: 及賊由青觀山逸出，追至方山坪，奮擊大潰，其清旋就擒。

translations.literal: When the rebels slipped out from Qingguanshan, he pursued them to Fangshanping, fought fiercely and routed them in great disorder, and Qiqing was soon captured.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels slipped out from Qingguanshan, he ran them down to Fangshanping, broke them in a fierce fight, and Qiqing was captured soon after.

sentences.zh: 四年春，從德楞泰破賊麻壩寨，獲文儔。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year he followed Delengtai in defeating the rebels at Maba Stockade and captured Wenchou.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Jiaqing 4 he followed Delengtai in storming Maba Stockade and took Wenchou prisoner.

sentences.zh: 既而蕭佔國、張長庚竄營山，額勒登保迎擊黃土坪，令射鬥扼其西，佔國、長庚就殲。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Xiao Zhanguo and Zhang Changgeng raided into Yingshan; Eledengbao met them at Huangtuping and ordered Shedou to block the west; Zhanguo and Changgeng were thereupon annihilated.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Xiao Zhanguo and Zhang Changgeng broke into Yingshan. Eledengbao met them at Huangtuping and sent Shedou to seal the western route; both rebel leaders were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 夏，包正洪潛匿鄰水，連敗之唐家坪、趙家場，追至開縣九龍山，痛殲之；

translations.literal: In summer Bao Zhenghong lay hidden in Linshui; Shedou defeated him repeatedly at Tangjiaping and Zhaojiachang, pursued him to Jiulongshan in Kai County, and inflicted a crushing defeat;
translations.idiomatic: That summer Bao Zhenghong was hiding in Linshui. Shedou beat him again and again at Tangjiaping and Zhaojiachang, ran him to Jiulongshan in Kai County, and destroyed his force;

sentences.zh: 窮追及毛坪，賊踞山，以火槍仰擊，斃正洪，予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: pursuing relentlessly to Maoping, where the rebels held the heights; he fired upward with muskets, killed Zhenghong, and was granted a hereditary post as Cavalry Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: pursued him all the way to Maoping, where the rebels held the heights. Firing muskets uphill, he killed Zhenghong and was granted a hereditary Cavalry Commandant's rank.

sentences.zh: 秋，破卜三聘於八石坪，又截擊高天德、馬學禮，擒其黨潘受榮。

translations.literal: In autumn he defeated Bu Sanpin at Bashiping and also intercepted Gao Tiande and Ma Xueli, capturing their follower Pan Shourong.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he routed Bu Sanpin at Bashiping, intercepted Gao Tiande and Ma Xueli, and seized their lieutenant Pan Shourong.

sentences.zh: 五年春，張世龍竄南江，迭敗之竹壩、草廟。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifth year Zhang Shilong raided into Nanjiang; Shedou defeated him repeatedly at Zhuba and Caomiao.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Jiaqing 5, when Zhang Shilong broke into Nanjiang, Shedou routed him at Zhuba and again at Caomiao.

sentences.zh: 會額勒登保、德楞泰先後赴陝，冉天元糾群賊乘虛入川。

translations.literal: Just then Eledengbao and Delengtai had gone in succession to Shaanxi; Ran Tianyuan gathered the rebel bands and seized the opportunity to enter Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: By then Eledengbao and Delengtai had both gone to Shaanxi, and Ran Tianyuan rallied the rebel bands to pour into Sichuan while the province lay exposed.

sentences.zh: 總督魁倫初任軍事，諸將中惟射鬥忠勇可恃，所部兵僅二千，至達州，賊已渡嘉陵江，乃自順慶渡河，迎擊於西充文井場，殲賊後隊；

translations.literal: Governor-General Kuilun had just taken charge of military affairs; among the generals only Shedou's loyalty and courage could be relied on. His command numbered only two thousand men. Reaching Dazhou, he found the rebels had already crossed the Jialing; he then crossed from Shunqing and met them at Wenjingchang in Xichong, annihilating the rebel rear guard;
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Kuilun had just assumed military command. Of all his generals, only Shedou's loyalty and courage could be trusted, and Shedou had barely two thousand men. At Dazhou he found the rebels had already crossed the Jialing. He crossed from Shunqing and met them at Wenjingchang in Xichong, wiping out their rear guard;

sentences.zh: 乘勝至蓬溪高院場，賊踞山下撲，眾數倍官軍，遂被圍。

translations.literal: pressing the victory to Gaoyuanchang in Pengxi, where the rebels held the foot of the hill and charged down; their numbers were several times those of the government army, and he was surrounded.
translations.idiomatic: then pressed on to Gaoyuanchang in Pengxi. The rebels held the lower slope and charged down in numbers several times his own, and he was surrounded.

sentences.zh: 魁倫初約自率兵繼進而不至，射鬥力戰，隊伍衝斷，手刃十餘人，遇坎墜馬，歿於陣。

translations.literal: Kuilun had at first promised to follow with his own troops but did not arrive; Shedou fought with all his strength, his ranks were broken through, he personally killed more than ten men, struck a ditch and fell from his horse, and died on the field.
translations.idiomatic: Kuilun had promised to follow with reinforcements but never came. Shedou fought on until his line was broken, killed more than ten men with his own hand, struck a ditch, was thrown from his horse, and died on the field.

sentences.zh: 仁宗悼惜，晉二等輕車都尉世職，依提督例賜卹，諡勇烈，入祀昭忠祠。

translations.literal: The Renzong Emperor mourned him; his hereditary rank was advanced to second-class Commandant of Chariots and Cavalry, condolence was granted on the scale for a provincial commander, he was given the posthumous title Yonglie, and he was enshrined in the Shrine of Loyalty and Fidelity.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Renzong mourned his loss. Shedou's hereditary rank was raised to second-class Commandant of Chariots and Cavalry, he received posthumous honors on the scale reserved for a provincial commander, was given the title Yonglie, and was enshrined in the Shrine of Loyalty and Fidelity.

sentences.zh: 後獲賊李自剛戕射鬥者，詔磔之，設射鬥靈致祭，复傳首祭墓。

translations.literal: Later the rebel Li Zigang, who had killed Shedou, was captured; an edict ordered him dismembered by slow slicing, a spirit tablet of Shedou set up for sacrifice, and his head again sent for offering at the tomb.
translations.idiomatic: Later Li Zigang, the rebel who had killed Shedou, was captured. The court ordered him executed by dismemberment, set up Shedou's spirit tablet for sacrifice, and sent his head again to be offered at the grave.

sentences.zh: 射鬥從軍三十四年，受高宗知，仁宗尤以宿將重之。

translations.literal: Shedou had served in the army for thirty-four years, was known to the Gaozong Emperor, and the Renzong Emperor especially valued him as a veteran general.
translations.idiomatic: Shedou had served thirty-four years in the army, had won the esteem of Emperor Gaozong, and Emperor Renzong held him in special regard as a veteran commander.

sentences.zh: 額勒登保入川數大捷，皆倚射鬥及楊遇春如左右手，賊畏之，號曰「硃虎」。

translations.literal: Eledengbao's several great victories after entering Sichuan all relied on Shedou and Yang Yuchun as his right and left hands; the rebels feared him and called him the "Zhu Tiger."
translations.idiomatic: Eledengbao's great victories in Sichuan depended on Shedou and Yang Yuchun as his right and left hands. The rebels feared him and called him the Zhu Tiger.

sentences.zh: 在軍得士心，尤卹難民，前後拯濟不下萬人。

translations.literal: In the army he won the hearts of his men and especially cared for refugees; in all he relieved no fewer than ten thousand people.
translations.idiomatic: In camp he won his soldiers' loyalty and was especially tender toward refugees, relieving no fewer than ten thousand people in all.

sentences.zh: 歿後兵民胥流涕。

translations.literal: After his death soldiers and civilians alike wept.
translations.idiomatic: After his death soldiers and civilians alike wept.

sentences.zh: 賊既退，收遺骸，遺左足，川民於戰處得之，瘞於潼川鳳皇山仙人掌，建祠以祀。

translations.literal: After the rebels withdrew, his remains were gathered; the left foot was missing. Sichuan people found it on the battlefield, buried it at Xianrenzhang on Fenghuang Mountain in Tongchuan, and built a shrine to worship him.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels withdrew, his body was recovered, but the left foot was missing. Local people found it on the battlefield, buried it at Xianrenzhang on Fenghuang Mountain in Tongchuan, and built a shrine in his honor.

sentences.zh: 子樹，襲世職，授戶部主事。

translations.literal: His son Shu inherited the hereditary rank and was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: His son Shu inherited the hereditary rank and was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 道光中，累官漕運總督，休致歸。

translations.literal: In the Daoguang reign he rose through repeated promotions to Grand Canal transport commissioner and retired home.
translations.idiomatic: Under Daoguang he rose to Grand Canal transport commissioner and retired home.

sentences.zh: 咸豐中，命治本籍團練捐輸事宜。

translations.literal: In the Xianfeng reign he was ordered to manage local militia training and contribution affairs in his native place.
translations.idiomatic: Under Xianfeng he was charged with organizing local militia and relief contributions in his home district.

sentences.zh: 同治初，卒。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tongzhi he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died early in the Tongzhi reign.

sentences.zh: 穆克登布，鈕祜祿氏，滿洲正紅旗人，將軍成德子。

translations.literal: Mu Kedengbu, of the Niohuru clan, was a Bannerman of the Plain Red Banner in Manchuria and a son of General Chengde.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Kedengbu, of the Niohuru clan, was a Plain Red Banner Manchu and the son of General Chengde.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中，成德駐西藏，入覲，高宗詢知穆克登布曾從征金川，授藍翎侍衛。

translations.literal: In the Qianlong reign Chengde was stationed in Tibet; on presenting himself at court, the Gaozong Emperor inquired and learned that Mu Kedengbu had campaigned in Jinchuan, and appointed him a Blue Lance Guardsman.
translations.idiomatic: During Qianlong, when Chengde was stationed in Tibet and came to court, Emperor Gaozong learned that Mu Kedengbu had fought in Jinchuan and appointed him a Blue Lance Guardsman.

sentences.zh: 累擢直隸提標游擊。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to guerrilla colonel under the Zhili provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in due course to guerrilla colonel on the staff of the Zhili provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，從剿湖北教匪，以功賞花翎。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he followed the suppression of the Hubei sect rebels and, for his merit, was awarded peacock feathers.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 1 he joined the campaign against the Hubei rebels and, for his service, was awarded peacock feathers.

sentences.zh: 遷山東參將，遂轉戰川、陝。

translations.literal: He was transferred to regimental commander in Shandong and then fought in succession in Sichuan and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was made regimental commander in Shandong and then fought through Sichuan and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 四年春，從惠齡克麻壩寨，加總兵銜，擢貴州清江協副將。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year he followed Huiling in capturing Maba Stockade, was given the brevet rank of commander, and was promoted to deputy commander of the Qingjiang Brigade in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Jiaqing 4 he followed Huiling in taking Maba Stockade, received brevet commander rank, and was promoted to deputy commander of the Qingjiang Brigade in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 從額勒登保殲閬中賊蕭佔國、張長庚，乘勝進剿冷天祿於岳池。

translations.literal: He followed Eledengbao in annihilating the Langzhong rebels Xiao Zhanguo and Zhang Changgeng, then pressed the victory to pursue Leng Tianlu at Yuechi.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Eledengbao in destroying the Langzhong rebels Xiao Zhanguo and Zhang Changgeng, then pressed on against Leng Tianlu at Yuechi.

sentences.zh: 令穆克登布先據人頭堰，與楊遇春夾擊，大破賊眾，殲天祿，賜號濟特庫勒特依巴圖魯。

translations.literal: Mu Kedengbu was ordered to seize Rentouyan first; with Yang Yuchun he attacked from both sides, routed the rebel host, destroyed Tianlu, and was granted the honorific title Jitekuleteyi Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Kedengbu was sent to seize Rentouyan first. Attacking with Yang Yuchun from both sides, he shattered the rebel force, destroyed Tianlu, and was awarded the honorific name Jitekuleteyi Baturu.

sentences.zh: 於是額勒登保軍威大振，遂任經略，穆克登布與楊遇春為左右翼長，常為軍鋒。

translations.literal: Thereupon Eledengbao's military prestige rose greatly; he was then appointed grand coordinator, with Mu Kedengbu and Yang Yuchun as his left and right wing commanders, often serving as the army's vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: Eledengbao's prestige soared, and he was made grand coordinator with Mu Kedengbu and Yang Yuchun as his wing commanders, often leading the vanguard.

sentences.zh: 冬，與七十五夾擊樊人傑於通江，敗之，擢山西太原鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In winter, with Qishiwu he attacked Fan Renjie at Tongjiang from both sides, defeated him, and was promoted to commander of the Taiyuan Garrison in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he and Qishiwu caught Fan Renjie at Tongjiang in a pincer, routed him, and he was promoted to commander of the Taiyuan Garrison in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 時川賊徐天德、王登廷、冉天元合撓官軍，阻餉道。

translations.literal: At that time the Sichuan rebels Xu Tiande, Wang Dengting, and Ran Tianyuan together harassed the government army and blocked the supply route.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Sichuan rebels Xu Tiande, Wang Dengting, and Ran Tianyuan were harrying government forces and cutting the supply line.

sentences.zh: 額勒登保以賊皆勁悍，集師合擊於蒼溪貓兒埡，議與穆克登布、楊遇春分三路進攻。

translations.literal: Eledengbao, considering all the rebels fierce and strong, gathered his forces for a joint attack at Mao'erya in Cangxi and planned with Mu Kedengbu and Yang Yuchun to advance in three columns.
translations.idiomatic: Judging the rebels too fierce to meet piecemeal, Eledengbao concentrated his forces at Mao'erya in Cangxi and planned a three-column assault with Mu Kedengbu and Yang Yuchun.

sentences.zh: 穆克登布恃勇，先期往，為賊所乘，腹背受敵，傷亡副將以下二十四人、士卒數百。

translations.literal: Mu Kedengbu, relying on his courage, went ahead of schedule, was taken advantage of by the rebels, and was attacked front and rear; deputy commanders and below to the number of twenty-four were killed or wounded, and several hundred soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Overconfident in his own courage, Mu Kedengbu went in early and was caught by the rebels between two fires. Twenty-four officers of deputy-commander rank and below were killed or wounded, along with several hundred soldiers.

sentences.zh: 及遇春至，據險與賊相持，經略中軍亦被攻，血戰竟夜，黎明賊始卻，登廷旋就擒。

translations.literal: When Yuchun arrived he held the defiles and locked in combat with the rebels; the grand coordinator's central army was also attacked; they fought in blood through the night, and at dawn the rebels at last withdrew; Dengting was soon captured.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuchun arrived he seized the high ground and fought the rebels to a standstill. The grand coordinator's main force came under attack as well. The battle raged through the night; at dawn the rebels finally withdrew, and Dengting was captured soon after.

sentences.zh: 偕遇春追天元至開縣，與德楞泰會師夾擊，賊勢乃蹙。

translations.literal: With Yuchun he pursued Tianyuan to Kai County, joined Delengtai's forces in a pincer attack, and the rebel power was then pressed hard.
translations.idiomatic: With Yuchun he pursued Tianyuan to Kai County, joined Delengtai in a pincer, and the rebel position collapsed.

sentences.zh: 五年，從經略入陝。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed the grand coordinator into Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 5 he followed the grand coordinator into Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 夏，與楊遇春合擊伍金柱於手扳崖、銅錢窖，追殲楊開甲於茅坪。

translations.literal: In summer, with Yang Yuchun he jointly attacked Wu Jinzhu at Shoubanya and Tongqianjiao, and pursued and annihilated Yang Kaijia at Maoping.
translations.idiomatic: That summer he and Yang Yuchun attacked Wu Jinzhu at Shoubanya and Tongqianjiao, then ran down and destroyed Yang Kaijia at Maoping.

sentences.zh: 秋，要擊張天倫於兩當剪子岩，追殺數十里。

translations.literal: In autumn he intercepted Zhang Tianlun at Jianziyan in Liangdang and pursued, killing rebels for several tens of li.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he intercepted Zhang Tianlun at Jianziyan in Liangdang and pursued the fleeing rebels for dozens of li.

sentences.zh: 賊折奔階州，遇於佛堂寺，擊敗之，斬其渠曾印。

translations.literal: The rebels turned and fled toward Jiezhou; he met them at Fotang Temple, defeated them, and beheaded their leader Zeng Yin.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels wheeled toward Jiezhou. He met them at Fotang Temple, routed them, and beheaded their leader Zeng Yin.

sentences.zh: 六年春，冉學勝將入陝，雪夜率勁騎沖之，賊潰，又敗伍懷志於五郎江口，擢乾清門侍衛。

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixth year Ran Xuesheng was about to enter Shaanxi; on a snowy night Mu Kedengbu led crack cavalry in a charge, the rebels collapsed, and he again defeated Wu Huaizhi at the mouth of the Wulang River; he was promoted to Guardsman of the Gate of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Jiaqing 6, when Ran Xuesheng was poised to enter Shaanxi, Mu Kedengbu led elite cavalry in a night charge through the snow and broke the rebels. He then defeated Wu Huaizhi at the mouth of the Wulang River and was promoted to Guardsman of the Gate of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 夏，伍懷志糾黨由漢北東竄，分兵晝夜窮追，及之於秦嶺，擒懷志，餘黨盡殲，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: In summer Wu Huaizhi gathered his band and fled east from north of the Han; Mu Kedengbu divided his forces and pursued day and night, overtook them at the Qinling Mountains, captured Huaizhi, annihilated the rest, and was granted a hereditary post as Cloud Cavalry Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: That summer Wu Huaizhi rallied his followers and broke east from north of the Han. Mu Kedengbu split his force and pursued without rest until he caught them in the Qinling, took Huaizhi prisoner, wiped out the rest, and was granted a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Commandant's rank.

sentences.zh: 七年，調湖南永州鎮，擢甘肅提督。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to the Yongzhou Garrison in Hunan and promoted to provincial commander of Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 7 he was transferred to the Yongzhou Garrison in Hunan and promoted to provincial commander of Gansu.

sentences.zh: 馳剿川東、湖北竄匪，破王國賢於平利，追入川，迭敗賊於青岡坪、太平坡，擒景英。

translations.literal: He galloped to suppress rebels raiding eastern Sichuan and Hubei, defeated Wang Guoxian at Pingli, pursued into Sichuan, repeatedly defeated rebels at Qinggangping and Taipingpo, and captured Jing Ying.
translations.idiomatic: He rode hard against rebels raiding eastern Sichuan and Hubei, routed Wang Guoxian at Pingli, pursued them into Sichuan, beat them again at Qinggangping and Taipingpo, and captured Jing Ying.

sentences.zh: 是年，軍事將蕆，錄諸將功，擢御前侍衛，晉騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: That year, as military affairs were nearing conclusion, the generals' merits were recorded; he was promoted to Imperial Bodyguard and advanced to hereditary Cavalry Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: That year, as the campaign drew toward its close, the court recorded the generals' merits, promoted him to Imperial Bodyguard, and advanced his hereditary rank to Cavalry Commandant.

sentences.zh: 八年春，搜捕餘匪，由巴峪關深入，擒宋應伏，又擒姚馨佐等於南江。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eighth year he searched out remaining rebels, penetrated deep through Bayu Pass, captured Song Yingfu, and also captured Yao Xinzuo and others at Nanjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Jiaqing 8 he hunted down the remaining rebels, pushed deep through Bayu Pass, took Song Yingfu, and captured Yao Xinzuo and others at Nanjiang.

sentences.zh: 應伏最悍，馨佐乃之富子，皆賊之著名者。

translations.literal: Yingfu was the fiercest; Xinzuo was the son of Yao Zhifu—both were famous among the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Yingfu was the most formidable of them; Xinzuo was Yao Zhifu's son—both were notorious rebel leaders.

sentences.zh: 應伏黨尚存馮天保、餘佐斌、熊老八，並百戰猾賊。

translations.literal: Among Yingfu's followers Feng Tianbao, Yu Zuobin, and Xiong Laoba still remained—all cunning veterans of a hundred battles.
translations.idiomatic: Yingfu's followers still included Feng Tianbao, Yu Zuobin, and Xiong Laoba, all wily veterans of countless fights.

sentences.zh: 熊老八年二十餘，死黨百餘，皆壯悍矯捷，所用矛長數丈，出沒老林，傷將士甚眾。

translations.literal: Xiong Laoba was just over twenty years old, with more than a hundred diehard followers, all strong, fierce, and agile; their spears were several zhang long; they lurked in the old forests and wounded many officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Xiong Laoba was barely twenty, with more than a hundred diehard followers—all powerful, fierce, and quick. They wielded spears many yards long, haunted the deep forests, and had killed or wounded a great many government troops.

sentences.zh: 至是，誘官軍入林，設伏狙伺。

translations.literal: At this point he lured the government army into the forest and set an ambush to lie in wait.
translations.idiomatic: Now he lured government troops into the forest and lay in ambush.

sentences.zh: 穆克登布卞急輕敵，勁卒又為他將分調，倉猝中矛，歿於陣，加予輕車都尉世職，並為二等男爵，諡剛烈。

translations.literal: Mu Kedengbu was impetuous and underestimated the enemy; his crack troops had also been detached by other generals; in the sudden encounter he was struck by a spear and died on the field. He was posthumously granted a hereditary Commandant of Chariots and Cavalry and made a second-class baron, with the posthumous title Ganglie.
translations.idiomatic: Impulsive and overconfident, Mu Kedengbu had also lost his best troops to other commanders' requisitions. In the sudden clash he took a spear thrust and died on the field. Posthumously he received a hereditary Commandant of Chariots and Cavalry, a second-class baron's rank, and the title Ganglie.

sentences.zh: 嚴詔捕熊老八，期必獲。

translations.literal: A stern edict ordered the capture of Xiong Laoba, with a fixed deadline for success.
translations.idiomatic: A stern edict demanded Xiong Laoba's capture within a set deadline.

sentences.zh: 武弁陳弼賄降俘取賊屍，偽冒以獻，立擢弼參將，傳首祭穆克登布墓。

translations.literal: The military officer Chen Bi bribed surrendered captives to obtain a rebel corpse, falsely presented it as Laoba's, and was immediately promoted to regimental commander; the head was sent for sacrifice at Mu Kedengbu's tomb.
translations.idiomatic: The officer Chen Bi bribed surrendered prisoners for a rebel corpse, passed it off as Laoba's, and was promptly promoted to regimental commander. The head was sent to Mu Kedengbu's tomb for sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 逾年，羅思舉始捕得老八，磔之，軍中不敢上聞。

translations.literal: More than a year later Luo Siju at last captured Laoba and had him dismembered; the army did not dare report it upward.
translations.idiomatic: More than a year later Luo Siju finally captured Laoba and had him executed by dismemberment. The army dared not report it to the court.

sentences.zh: 子頤齡，襲爵，二等侍衛，孝全成皇后之父也。

translations.literal: His son Yiling inherited the title, served as a second-class guardsman, and was the father of Empress Xiaoquancheng.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yiling inherited the title, served as a second-class guardsman, and was the father of Empress Xiaoquancheng.

sentences.zh: 道光十四年，冊立皇后禮成，追封一等承恩侯，抬入鑲黃旗，諡榮僖，以孫瑚圖哩兼襲兩爵。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Daoguang, when the empress's installation ceremony was completed, he was posthumously enfeoffed as a first-class Marquis Who Received Grace, transferred into the Bordered Yellow Banner, given the posthumous title Rongxi, and his grandson Hutuli was made to inherit both titles jointly.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 14, after the empress's installation, he was posthumously made a first-class Marquis Who Received Grace, transferred to the Bordered Yellow Banner, given the title Rongxi, and his grandson Hutuli was allowed to hold both ranks jointly.

sentences.zh: 三十年，文宗即位，晉封三等承恩公，以長子文壽襲，次子文瑞襲男爵。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, when the Wenzong Emperor acceded, the rank was advanced to third-class Duke Who Received Grace; the eldest son Wenshou inherited it, and the second son Wenrui inherited the barony.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 30, when Emperor Wenzong came to the throne, the rank was raised to third-class Duke Who Received Grace. The eldest son Wenshou inherited the dukedom, and the second son Wenrui inherited the barony.

sentences.zh: 富成，石莫勒氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Fu Cheng, of the Shimole clan, was a Bannerman of the Bordered Yellow Banner in Manchuria.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Cheng, of the Shimole clan, was a Bordered Yellow Banner Manchu.

sentences.zh: 起健銳營前鋒，從征烏什、大小金川，積勞至參領，歷火器營營總。

translations.literal: He began as a vanguard in the Vanguard Camp, campaigned at Ush and the Greater and Lesser Jinchuan, rose through accumulated service to company commander, and served as battalion chief in the Firearms Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: He began as a vanguard in the Vanguard Camp, fought at Ush and in the Greater and Lesser Jinchuan campaigns, rose to company commander, and served as battalion chief in the Firearms Brigade.

sentences.zh: 出為廣西、直隸副將，擢山西太原鎮總兵。

translations.literal: He went out to serve as deputy commander in Guangxi and Zhili and was promoted to commander of the Taiyuan Garrison in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He served as deputy commander in Guangxi and Zhili and was promoted to commander of the Taiyuan Garrison in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 坐失察盜馬賊入邊，降京營游擊。

translations.literal: For failure to detect horse-thief bandits crossing the border, he was demoted to guerrilla colonel in the capital garrison.
translations.idiomatic: For failing to stop horse-thief bandits from crossing the border, he was demoted to guerrilla colonel in the capital garrison.

sentences.zh: 复擢山東兗州鎮總兵。

translations.literal: He was again promoted to commander of the Yanzhou Garrison in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: He was restored and promoted to commander of the Yanzhou Garrison in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，教匪起，率本鎮兵赴河南協剿。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing, when the sect rebels rose, he led the troops of his garrison to Henan to assist in suppression.
translations.idiomatic: When the sect rebels rose in Jiaqing 1, he led his garrison troops to Henan to join the suppression.

sentences.zh: 先清鄧州賊巢，進剿呂堰驛、隨州紅土山，黃玉書就擒，敘功，以提督升用。

translations.literal: He first cleared the rebel nest at Dengzhou, advanced to suppress rebels at Luyanyi and Hongtushan in Suizhou; Huang Yushu was captured; his merit was recorded, and he was marked for promotion to provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: He first cleared the rebel nest at Dengzhou, then struck Luyanyi and Hongtushan in Suizhou and captured Huang Yushu. His merit earned him selection for promotion to provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 又連敗賊於鍾祥鄧家岡、香花園、南線畈。

translations.literal: He again defeated rebels in succession at Dengjiagang, Xianghuayuan, and Nanxianfan in Zhongxiang.
translations.idiomatic: He then routed the rebels again at Dengjiagang, Xianghuayuan, and Nanxianfan in Zhongxiang.

sentences.zh: 命兼領直隸、吉林新調兵。

translations.literal: He was ordered also to take command of newly transferred troops from Zhili and Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: He was also placed in command of newly transferred troops from Zhili and Jilin.

sentences.zh: 二年，進攻梁家集，總統惠齡與賊戰槐樹岡，富成聞砲聲，馳往夾擊，大敗之。

translations.literal: In the second year he advanced on Liangjiaji; Commander-in-Chief Huiling was fighting the rebels at Huaishugang; Fu Cheng heard the gunfire, galloped to join in a pincer attack, and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 2 he advanced on Liangjiaji. Commander Huiling was fighting the rebels at Huaishugang; hearing the guns, Fu Cheng galloped to the scene and, attacking from both sides, routed them.

sentences.zh: 偕慶成合擊劉起榮，又敗賊於溫峽口。

translations.literal: Together with Qing Cheng he jointly attacked Liu Qirong and again defeated rebels at Wenxiakou.
translations.idiomatic: With Qing Cheng he attacked Liu Qirong and again beat the rebels at Wenxiakou.

sentences.zh: 襄匪由河南竄入陝境，總督宜綿疏調富成赴西安，率甘肅兵二千、回兵二千助剿。

translations.literal: The Xiangyang rebels raided from Henan into Shaanxi; Governor-General Yi Mian memorialized to transfer Fu Cheng to Xi'an, leading two thousand Gansu troops and two thousand Muslim troops to assist in suppression.
translations.idiomatic: When the Xiangyang rebels crossed from Henan into Shaanxi, Governor-General Yi Mian requested Fu Cheng at Xi'an with two thousand Gansu troops and two thousand Muslim auxiliaries.

sentences.zh: 夏，分兵五路圍賊於大涼山下，殲賊千餘，擒其渠李天德等，又連敗賊於雙河口、青莊坪、放牛坡、大石川，擢江南提督。

translations.literal: In summer he divided his forces into five routes to surround the rebels below Daliang Mountain, annihilated more than a thousand rebels, captured their leader Li Tiande and others, again defeated rebels in succession at Shuanghekou, Qingzhuangping, Fangniupo, and Dashichuan, and was promoted to provincial commander of Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: That summer he surrounded the rebels below Daliang Mountain in five columns, killed more than a thousand, and captured Li Tiande and other leaders. He then beat them again at Shuanghekou, Qingzhuangping, Fangniupo, and Dashichuan and was promoted to provincial commander of Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 赴漢中寧羌，扼川賊入竄之路，循漢南而西，與明亮夾攻，賊距江近，佯引兵入山，圖潛渡，富成繞出賊後兜擊之，斬獲甚眾，被獎賚。

translations.literal: He went to Ningqiang in Hanzhong, blocked the route by which Sichuan rebels might raid in, proceeded west along the south bank of the Han, and with Ming Liang attacked from both sides. The rebels, near the river, feigned to lead troops into the mountains intending a secret crossing; Fu Cheng circled behind them and struck in an encircling attack, killing and capturing in great numbers, and was rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: He moved to Ningqiang in Hanzhong to block Sichuan rebels from raiding in, then marched west along the south Han with Ming Liang in a pincer. The rebels, close to the river, pretended to withdraw into the hills to ford in secret. Fu Cheng swung behind them and cut them down in great numbers, earning imperial rewards.

sentences.zh: 三年春，赴達州擊退犯城賊，通新寧運道，又連敗賊於竇山關、木竹坪、白山寺，擢成都將軍。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year he went to Dazhou, repelled rebels attacking the city, opened the transport route to Xinning, again defeated rebels in succession at Doushanguan, Muzhuping, and Baishansi, and was promoted to General of Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Jiaqing 3 he went to Dazhou, drove off rebels besieging the city, reopened the supply route to Xinning, routed the rebels at Doushanguan, Muzhuping, and Baishansi, and was promoted to General of Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 命剿徐天德，屢詔責戰甚急。

translations.literal: He was ordered to suppress Xu Tiande; repeated edicts rebuked him for slow fighting.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to destroy Xu Tiande, and repeated edicts rebuked him for moving too slowly.

sentences.zh: 冬，戰清涼寺，殲賊數百。

translations.literal: In winter he fought at Qingliang Temple and annihilated several hundred rebels.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he fought at Qingliang Temple and killed several hundred rebels.

sentences.zh: 四年，張映祥竄廣元、寧羌，擊之毛家山，又與恆瑞夾擊於略陽、階州。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Zhang Yingxiang raided into Guangyuan and Ningqiang; Fu Cheng attacked him at Maojiashan and again, with Heng Rui, struck from both sides at Lueyang and Jiezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 4, when Zhang Yingxiang raided Guangyuan and Ningqiang, Fu Cheng struck him at Maojiashan and, with Heng Rui, attacked from both sides at Lueyang and Jiezhou.

sentences.zh: 經略勒保疏言其兵力不足，未能製賊，褫職逮問。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Le Bao memorialized that his forces were insufficient and he could not subdue the rebels; his office was stripped and he was arrested for investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Le Bao reported that Fu Cheng lacked the strength to master the rebels. He was dismissed and arrested for investigation.

sentences.zh: 會富成連敗賊於黃家坪、大水溝、黨家坪、蔣家坪，詔免治罪，以披甲留營效力，駐鎮安防剿。

translations.literal: Just then Fu Cheng repeatedly defeated rebels at Huangjiaping, Dashuigou, Dangjiaping, and Jiangjiaping; an edict exempted him from punishment, allowed him to remain in camp in armor to render service, and stationed him at Zhen'an for suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Fu Cheng routed the rebels at Huangjiaping, Dashuigou, Dangjiaping, and Jiangjiaping. An edict spared him punishment and let him serve in the ranks at Zhen'an.

sentences.zh: 五年夏，總督長麟追剿冉學勝、伍金柱等，而高天德、馬學禮亦來犯，富成馳援徽縣。

translations.literal: In the summer of the fifth year Governor-General Chang Lin pursued Ran Xuesheng, Wu Jinzhu, and others, while Gao Tiande and Ma Xueli also came to attack; Fu Cheng galloped to reinforce Huixian.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of Jiaqing 5, while Governor-General Chang Lin pursued Ran Xuesheng and Wu Jinzhu, Gao Tiande and Ma Xueli also attacked. Fu Cheng galloped to reinforce Huixian.

sentences.zh: 賊襲長麟營，官軍敗績於架子山，富成力戰被重創，遂歿於陣。

translations.literal: The rebels assaulted Chang Lin's camp; the government army suffered defeat at Jiazishan; Fu Cheng fought fiercely, received grave wounds, and died on the field.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels struck Chang Lin's camp, government forces were beaten at Jiazishan. Fu Cheng fought on until he was gravely wounded and died on the field.

sentences.zh: 上初以剿張映祥久無功，故加重譴，至是惜之，命入祀昭忠祠，予雲騎尉世職，子三等侍衛普亮襲。

translations.literal: The emperor had at first imposed heavier punishment because the campaign against Zhang Yingxiang had long been without success; now he regretted it, ordered Fu Cheng enshrined in the Shrine of Loyalty and Fidelity, granted a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Commandant's post, and his son Puliang, a third-class guardsman, inherited.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had first punished him harshly for failing to catch Zhang Yingxiang, but now mourned his loss. Fu Cheng was enshrined in the Shrine of Loyalty and Fidelity, granted a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Commandant's rank, and his son Puliang, a third-class guardsman, inherited.

sentences.zh: 時軍事久不定，兵多，或事剽掠，鄉勇尤甚，人目為「紅蓮教」。

translations.literal: At that time military affairs had long been unsettled; with many troops, some turned to plunder, especially the local militia, whom people regarded as the "Red Lotus Sect."
translations.idiomatic: The war had dragged on so long that many troops, and especially the local militia, turned to looting. People called them the Red Lotus Sect.

sentences.zh: 富成與總兵穆維馭下較嚴，為時所稱雲。

translations.literal: Fu Cheng and Commander Mu Weiyu were comparatively strict with their subordinates and were praised at the time.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Cheng and Commander Mu Weiyu kept unusually tight discipline among their men, and contemporaries spoke well of them.

sentences.zh: 維，直隸清苑人。

translations.literal: Wei was a native of Qingyuan in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Wei came from Qingyuan in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 隸督標。

translations.literal: He served under the provincial commander's standard.
translations.idiomatic: He served in the provincial commander's guard.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中，山東王倫倡亂，以陣斬賊渠楊壘功，擢千總。

translations.literal: In the Qianlong reign Wang Lun incited rebellion in Shandong; for killing the rebel chieftain Yang Lei in battle, Wei was promoted to company commander.
translations.idiomatic: During Qianlong, when Wang Lun raised a revolt in Shandong, Wei killed the rebel leader Yang Lei in battle and was promoted to company commander.

sentences.zh: 賊聞京兵南下，掠糧艘造浮橋，圖西竄，維直搏獲賊砲二，焚其橋，賜號奮勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: Hearing that capital troops were marching south, the rebels seized grain boats to build a pontoon bridge and planned to flee west; Wei charged straight in, captured two rebel cannon, burned the bridge, and was granted the honorific title Fenyong Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels heard capital troops were marching south, they seized grain boats to build a pontoon bridge for a westward escape. Wei charged in headlong, seized two rebel guns, burned the bridge, and was awarded the honorific name Fenyong Baturu.

sentences.zh: 累擢膠州協副將。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to deputy commander of the Jiaozhou Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in due course to deputy commander of the Jiaozhou Brigade.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，偕富成赴襄陽。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he went with Fu Cheng to Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 1 he went with Fu Cheng to Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 恆瑞攻劉家集，維率騎兵橫貫賊營，大軍躡其後，獲大捷。

translations.literal: When Heng Rui attacked Liujiaji, Wei led cavalry straight through the rebel camp; the main army followed close behind and won a great victory.
translations.idiomatic: At Liujiaji, while Heng Rui attacked the front, Wei led cavalry straight through the rebel camp and the main force followed for a great victory.

sentences.zh: 師次滾河，賊屯對岸董家岡、梁家坳，維偕王文雄選精兵夜潛渡，破賊營。

translations.literal: The army halted at Gunhe; the rebels were encamped on the opposite bank at Dongjiagang and Liangjia'ao; Wei, with Wang Wenxiong, chose elite troops to cross secretly by night and broke the rebel camps.
translations.idiomatic: At Gunhe the rebels held Dongjiagang and Liangjia'ao on the far bank. Wei and Wang Wenxiong chose elite troops, crossed by night in secret, and stormed the rebel camps.

sentences.zh: 二年，擢登州鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the second year he was promoted to commander of the Dengzhou Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 2 he was promoted to commander of the Dengzhou Garrison.

sentences.zh: 冬，高均德、王廷詔分擾班鳩關，窺渡漢江，偕副都統六十七連敗之雙河塘、土門埡，被優獎。

translations.literal: In winter Gao Junde and Wang Tingzhao separately harassed Banjiuguan, watching for a chance to cross the Han River; with Vice Commander-in-Chief Qishiliu he repeatedly defeated them at Shuanghetang and Tumenya and received special commendation.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Gao Junde and Wang Tingzhao threatened Banjiuguan and eyed a crossing of the Han. With Vice Commander Qishiliu, Wei beat them at Shuanghetang and Tumenya and received special commendation.

sentences.zh: 三年春，赴四川，從勒保敗王三槐、徐天德於石壩山，偕富成要賊竹峪關、洪口諸隘，又敗冉文儔於黑馬山。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year he went to Sichuan, followed Le Bao in defeating Wang Sanhuai and Xu Tiande at Shibashan, with Fu Cheng intercepted the rebels at Zhuyuguan, Hongkou, and other passes, and again defeated Ran Wenchou at Heimashan.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Jiaqing 3 he went to Sichuan, followed Le Bao in routing Wang Sanhuai and Xu Tiande at Shibashan, blocked the rebels with Fu Cheng at Zhuyuguan and Hongkou, and beat Ran Wenchou at Heimashan.

sentences.zh: 夏，賊出李家山西逸，要之大完山，以砲俯擊，賊退，他將乘勢追擊。

translations.literal: In summer the rebels slipped out west from Lijia Mountain; he intercepted them at Dawanshan, fired downward with cannon, the rebels withdrew, and other generals pursued with the momentum.
translations.idiomatic: That summer the rebels slipped west from Lijia Mountain. Wei intercepted them at Dawanshan, shelled them from above, and when they fell back other generals pressed the pursuit.

sentences.zh: 維直搗李華寺，破賊巢，勞甚致疾，卒於軍，詔視陣亡例賜卹。

translations.literal: Wei drove straight at Lihuasi, broke the rebel nest, fell gravely ill from overwork, and died in the army; an edict granted condolence on the scale for death in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Wei stormed Lihuasi and destroyed the rebel nest, but overwork brought on a fatal illness and he died in camp. The court granted him posthumous honors on the scale for death in battle.

sentences.zh: 施縉，陝西定邊人。

translations.literal: Shi Jin was a native of Dingbian in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Jin came from Dingbian in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 由行伍從征緬甸，累擢雲貴督標都司。

translations.literal: Rising from the ranks, he campaigned in Burma and was repeatedly promoted to battalion commander under the Yunnan-Guizhou provincial commander's standard.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through the ranks on the Burma campaign and was promoted to battalion commander on the Yunnan-Guizhou provincial staff.

sentences.zh: 苗疆事起，應調隨徵，屢有功，賜號毅勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: When trouble arose in the Miao frontier he answered the call and followed on campaign, achieved merit repeatedly, and was granted the honorific title Yiyong Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: When the Miao frontier rose in revolt he answered the call, fought with distinction, and was awarded the honorific name Yiyong Baturu.

sentences.zh: 累擢湖南參將。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to regimental commander in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in due course to regimental commander in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，從總督勒保剿貴州仲苗。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing he followed Governor-General Le Bao in suppressing the Central Miao of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 2 he followed Governor-General Le Bao against the Central Miao of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 三月，連克關嶺、巴隴諸要隘，進逼永寧，克下山塘賊寨，解新城圍。

translations.literal: In the third month he captured in succession the strategic passes at Guanling and Balong, pressed toward Yongning, took the Shantang rebel stockade, and lifted the siege of Xincheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he took Guanling, Balong, and other key passes, pressed toward Yongning, stormed the Shantang stockade, and lifted the siege of Xincheng.

sentences.zh: 五月，與總兵張玉龍分兩翼，進克望城坡、碧峰山賊寨，攻羊腸山，追賊至新店，擒其渠梁阿站等，擢副將。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, with Commander Zhang Yulong dividing into two wings, he advanced and captured the rebel stockades at Wangchengpo and Bifengshan, attacked Yangchangshan, pursued the rebels to Xindian, captured their chieftain Liang Azhan and others, and was promoted to deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he and Commander Zhang Yulong attacked in two wings, took the stockades at Wangchengpo and Bifengshan, stormed Yangchangshan, ran the rebels to Xindian, captured Liang Azhan and other leaders, and was promoted to deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 六月，從勒保攻克水煙坪，偕按察使常明設伏八角洞坡，進攻阿捧，毀寨十一。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he followed Le Bao in capturing Shuiyanping, with Provincial Judicial Commissioner Chang Ming set an ambush at Bajiaodongpo, advanced to attack Apeng, and destroyed eleven stockades.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he followed Le Bao in taking Shuiyanping, laid an ambush with Judicial Commissioner Chang Ming at Bajiaodongpo, attacked Apeng, and destroyed eleven stockades.

sentences.zh: 大軍進卡子河，縉分克納賴坡、雞灣寨，攻普坪，渡河解南籠圍；

translations.literal: As the main army advanced on Kazihe, Jin separately captured Nalaipo and Jiwanzhai, attacked Puping, crossed the river and lifted the siege of Nanlong;
translations.idiomatic: As the main army advanced on Kazihe, Jin took Nalaipo and Jiwanzhai, attacked Puping, crossed the river, and lifted the siege of Nanlong;

sentences.zh: 進攻九頭山，擒賊渠陸寶貴，焚其巢，克馬鞭田山寨。

translations.literal: he advanced on Jiutoushan, captured the rebel chieftain Lu Baogui, burned their nest, and took the Mabiantian Mountain stockade.
translations.idiomatic: then stormed Jiutoushan, captured Lu Baogui, burned the rebel nest, and took the Mabiantian stockade.

sentences.zh: 七月，破韋七綹須於普磨，擒其孥，圍阿召山梁李景寨，設伏破援賊，擢臨元鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he defeated Wei Qixuxu at Pumo, captured his family, besieged the Lijing stockade on the Aizhao mountain ridge, set an ambush and defeated relieving rebels, and was promoted to commander of the Linyuan Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he routed Wei Qixuxu at Pumo, seized his family, besieged the Lijing stockade on the Aizhao ridge, ambushed and broke the relief force, and was promoted to commander of the Linyuan Garrison.

sentences.zh: 偕常明攻安有大寨，率勇士攀藤上，克之，擒賊渠賀阿豆、吳阿降。

translations.literal: With Chang Ming he attacked the Anyou great stockade, led brave men climbing up by vines, captured it, and seized the rebel chieftains He A'dou and Wu A'jiang.
translations.idiomatic: With Chang Ming he attacked the great Anyou stockade, led his men up the cliffs by vines, took the place, and captured He A'dou and Wu A'jiang.

sentences.zh: 九月，從勒保克洞灑賊巢，擒首逆韋七綹須。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he followed Le Bao in capturing the Dongsa rebel nest and seized the chief rebel Wei Qixuxu.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he followed Le Bao in taking the Dongsa stockade and captured the rebel leader Wei Qixuxu.

sentences.zh: 十一月，搜剿上下羅障，直達關嶺，前後克寨二十。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he searched out and suppressed rebels in upper and lower Luozhang, reached Guanling directly, and in all captured twenty stockades before and after.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he swept upper and lower Luozhang as far as Guanling and took twenty stockades in all.

sentences.zh: 調貴州安義鎮。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Anyi Garrison in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Anyi Garrison in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月，偕總兵七格等搜剿各路，乘勝擊壩鬱、邅峒諸寨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, with Commander Qige and others he searched and suppressed along various routes, pressed the victory to strike the stockades at Bayu, Qiantong, and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he and Commander Qige swept several routes and, pressing the advantage, struck the stockades at Bayu, Qiantong, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 自捧鮓至黃草壩，賊皆淨盡。

translations.literal: From Pengzha to Huangcaoba the rebels were entirely cleared away.
translations.idiomatic: From Pengzha to Huangcaoba the rebels were wiped out completely.

sentences.zh: 松林、紅岩、石門坎、香爐箐諸苗，尚負固抗拒，要擊破之，焚寨十九，特詔嘉獎，予優敘。

translations.literal: The Miao at Songlin, Hongyan, Shimenkan, Xiangluqing, and elsewhere still held firm in resistance; he intercepted and defeated them, burned nineteen stockades, received a special edict of praise, and was granted preferential promotion.
translations.idiomatic: The Miao at Songlin, Hongyan, Shimenkan, and Xiangluqing still held out. He intercepted and broke them, burned nineteen stockades, and received a special edict of praise with preferential promotion.

sentences.zh: 三年，復從總督鄂輝進剿兩薛岩、師趙屯諸苗，克寨五十，苗境遂平。

translations.literal: In the third year he again followed Governor-General Ehui in suppressing the Miao at Liangxueyan, Shizhaotun, and elsewhere, captured fifty stockades, and the Miao frontier was then pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he again followed Governor-General Ehui against the Miao at Liangxueyan and Shizhaotun, took fifty stockades, and the Miao frontier was pacified.

sentences.zh: 五年春，四川教匪复熾，起用勒保，會貴州巡撫常明薦縉率貴州兵往協剿，仁宗知縉剿仲苗奮勇冠軍，為勒保舊部，兵將相習，命所領自為一軍；

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifth year the Sichuan sect rebels flared up again; Le Bao was reappointed; Guizhou Governor Chang Ming recommended Jin to lead Guizhou troops to assist in suppression; the Renzong Emperor knew that Jin had been foremost in valor against the Central Miao, was an old subordinate of Le Bao, and that troops and officers were accustomed to one another, and ordered the force he led to form an independent army;
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Jiaqing 5 the Sichuan rebels flared up again and Le Bao was recalled. Guizhou governor Chang Ming recommended Jin to lead Guizhou troops to assist. Emperor Renzong knew Jin had been the boldest fighter against the Central Miao, that he was an old subordinate of Le Bao, and that his men knew the command well, and ordered his force to operate as an independent army;

sentences.zh: 又慮地利賊情未悉，聽德楞泰節制。

translations.literal: yet fearing he did not know the terrain and rebel conditions, allowed Delengtai to exercise overall control.
translations.idiomatic: but fearing he did not know the local terrain and rebel dispositions, placed him under Delengtai's overall command.

sentences.zh: 三月，至潼川，連破賊於大雙墩、潼河岸。

translations.literal: In the third month he reached Tongchuan and repeatedly defeated rebels at Dashuangdun and on the banks of the Tong River.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he reached Tongchuan and routed the rebels at Dashuangdun and along the Tong River.

sentences.zh: 四月，高天德、馬學禮由甘肅竄農安，從勒保迎擊盤龍驛、漩河口，敗之，偕阿哈保迎擊於黃連埡。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Gao Tiande and Ma Xueli raided from Gansu into Nong'an; following Le Bao he met them at Panlongyi and Xuanhekou and defeated them, and with Ahabao intercepted them at Huanglianya.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Gao Tiande and Ma Xueli broke in from Gansu toward Nong'an. Following Le Bao, Jin met and beat them at Panlongyi and Xuanhekou, then with Ahabao intercepted them at Huanglianya.

sentences.zh: 白號、藍號眾賊竄合江口，奪渡嘉陵江，偕阿哈保分四路進擊，大敗之。

translations.literal: The White Banner and Blue Banner rebels fled to Hejiangkou, seized a crossing of the Jialing River; with Ahabao he divided into four routes to attack and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: White- and Blue-faction rebels fled to Hejiangkou and forced a crossing of the Jialing. With Ahabao he attacked in four columns and routed them.

sentences.zh: 詔以嘉陵江西肅清，貴州兵新到屢捷，特予褒敘。

translations.literal: An edict praised the west bank of the Jialing as cleared, and the newly arrived Guizhou troops for their repeated victories, granting special commendation.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised the clearing of the west bank of the Jialing and the repeated victories of the newly arrived Guizhou troops, with special commendation.

sentences.zh: 時高、馬二賊欲與藍、白諸號合屯竹子山，勒保以龍安西北兩面俱通番地，議分三路兜剿，自率一軍出東北，一軍出西北，而以縉軍由南進。

translations.literal: At that time the Gao and Ma rebels wished to join the Blue and White factions in encamping at Zhuzishan; Le Bao, considering that northwest and northeast of Long'an both connected with tribal territory, planned a three-route encircling suppression: he himself would lead one army northeast, one army northwest, and Jin's force would advance from the south.
translations.idiomatic: Gao and Ma planned to join the Blue and White factions at Zhuzishan. Le Bao, noting that both northwest and northeast of Long'an opened onto tribal country, planned a three-pronged encirclement: he would take the northeast, another force the northwest, and Jin would advance from the south.

sentences.zh: 甫抵山南，賊乘高下壓，縉揮軍迎擊，奮力急戰；

translations.literal: Just as he reached the south slope of the mountain, the rebels pressed down from the heights; Jin directed his troops to meet the attack and fought fiercely in haste;
translations.idiomatic: As he reached the southern slope, the rebels pressed down from above. Jin led his men to meet them and fought with desperate energy;

sentences.zh: 賊來益眾，猝受矛傷，殞於陣。

translations.literal: the rebels came in ever greater numbers; he was suddenly struck by a spear and died on the field.
translations.idiomatic: but the rebels kept coming. He took a spear thrust and died on the field.

sentences.zh: 縉最為勒保所倚，至川以不習地勢致敗，優詔依提督例賜卹，稱為驍將，予騎都尉兼雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: Jin was most relied on by Le Bao; in Sichuan he failed through unfamiliarity with the terrain; a gracious edict granted condolence on the scale for a provincial commander, called him a fierce general, and awarded a hereditary Cavalry Commandant combined with Cloud Cavalry Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Jin had been Le Bao's most trusted fighter, but in Sichuan unfamiliar terrain undid him. A gracious edict granted him posthumous honors on the scale for a provincial commander, praised him as a fierce general, and awarded a combined hereditary Cavalry and Cloud Cavalry Commandant's rank.

sentences.zh: 子登科，襲騎都尉；

translations.literal: His son Dengke inherited the Cavalry Commandant's rank;
translations.idiomatic: His son Dengke inherited the Cavalry Commandant's rank;

sentences.zh: 佔科，襲雲騎尉。

translations.literal: Zhanke inherited the Cloud Cavalry Commandant's rank.
translations.idiomatic: Zhanke inherited the Cloud Cavalry Commandant's rank.

sentences.zh: 李紹祖，順天大興人。

translations.literal: Li Shaozu was a native of Daxing in Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shaozu came from Daxing in the capital district.

sentences.zh: 以武進士授三等侍衛。

translations.literal: As a military jinshi he was appointed a third-class guardsman.
translations.idiomatic: As a military jinshi he was appointed a third-class guardsman.

sentences.zh: 出為山東武定營游擊，累遷臨清協副將。

translations.literal: He went out to serve as guerrilla colonel of the Wuding Camp in Shandong and was repeatedly promoted to deputy commander of the Linqing Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: He served as guerrilla colonel of the Wuding Camp in Shandong and rose to deputy commander of the Linqing Brigade.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，赴襄陽，數擊賊有功，賞花翎。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he went to Xiangyang, repeatedly attacked rebels with merit, and was awarded peacock feathers.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 1 he went to Xiangyang, fought the rebels with repeated success, and was awarded peacock feathers.

sentences.zh: 二年，從恆瑞赴四川，迭敗賊於田家壩、大寧山梁、金子梁。

translations.literal: In the second year he followed Heng Rui to Sichuan and repeatedly defeated rebels at Tianjiaba, Daning Shanliang, and Jinziliang.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 2 he followed Heng Rui to Sichuan and routed the rebels at Tianjiaba, Daning Shanliang, and Jinziliang.

sentences.zh: 三年，擢甘肅巴里坤總兵。

translations.literal: In the third year he was promoted to commander of Barkol in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 3 he was promoted to commander at Barkol in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 秋，合攻打石坡、插旗山、古戰坪，皆捷。

translations.literal: In autumn he joined in attacks on Shipo, Chaqishan, and Guzhanping, all victorious.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he joined assaults on Shipo, Chaqishan, and Guzhanping, all successful.

sentences.zh: 冬，從惠齡克馬鞍山賊巢。

translations.literal: In winter he followed Huiling in capturing the rebel nest at Ma'anshan.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he followed Huiling in taking the rebel nest at Ma'anshan.

sentences.zh: 四年夏，從德楞泰擊賊於王家壩、川埡子。

translations.literal: In the summer of the fourth year he followed Delengtai in attacking rebels at Wangjiaba and Chuanyazi.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of Jiaqing 4 he followed Delengtai against the rebels at Wangjiaba and Chuanyazi.

sentences.zh: 秋，偕七十五破樊人傑於開縣，又敗之臨江市。

translations.literal: In autumn, with Qishiwu he defeated Fan Renjie at Kai County and again defeated him at Linjiang City.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he and Qishiwu routed Fan Renjie at Kai County and again at Linjiang.

sentences.zh: 五年春，冉天元等渡嘉陵江，總督魁倫調七十五往援，會其病，以兵付紹祖，率赴川西，進擊鹽亭、南部。
