translations.literal: In the spring of the fifth year Ran Tianyuan and others crossed the Jialing River; Governor-General Kuilun transferred Qishiwu to reinforce; when Qishiwu fell ill his troops were given to Shaozu, who led them to western Sichuan and advanced against Yanting and Nanbu.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Jiaqing 5, when Ran Tianyuan crossed the Jialing, Governor-General Kuilun sent Qishiwu to reinforce. Qishiwu fell ill and entrusted his troops to Shaozu, who led them into western Sichuan against Yanting and Nanbu.

sentences.zh: 德楞泰擊賊於江油白家壩，檄紹祖馳赴，賊踞箐林口，宵犯紹祖營，擊卻之。

translations.literal: Delengtai attacked rebels at Baijiaba in Jiangyou and summoned Shaozu to gallop to his aid; the rebels held Qinglinkou, raided Shaozu's camp by night, and were repulsed.
translations.idiomatic: Delengtai fought the rebels at Baijiaba in Jiangyou and summoned Shaozu. The rebels held Qinglinkou and raided his camp by night, but he drove them off.

sentences.zh: 賊諜詭稱難民，詣營獻計，誘官軍往，德楞泰知其詐，率紹祖掩擊之，大捷，追敗之於包家溝，進戰火石埡。

translations.literal: A rebel spy falsely claimed to be a refugee, came to camp to offer a plan, and lured the government army forward; Delengtai knew it was a trick, led Shaozu in a surprise attack, won a great victory, pursued and defeated them at Baojiagou, and advanced to fight at Huoshiya.
translations.idiomatic: A rebel spy posing as a refugee came to camp with a ruse to lure government troops forward. Delengtai saw through it and, with Shaozu, struck by surprise for a great victory, pursued the rebels to Baojiagou, and fought on at Huoshiya.

sentences.zh: 以功被優敘。

translations.literal: For his merit he received preferential promotion.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he received preferential promotion.

sentences.zh: 詔以川西略定，命紹祖率貴州兵赴陝，額勒登保疏請仍留川，遂從德楞泰擊張子聰於中江黃鹿山、硃家坪，擒斬甚眾。

translations.literal: An edict, considering western Sichuan largely pacified, ordered Shaozu to lead Guizhou troops to Shaanxi; Eledengbao memorialized asking that he remain in Sichuan; he then followed Delengtai in attacking Zhang Zicong at Huanglushan and Zhujiaping in Zhongjiang, capturing and killing in great numbers.
translations.idiomatic: An edict, judging western Sichuan largely pacified, ordered Shaozu to lead Guizhou troops to Shaanxi, but Eledengbao asked that he stay in Sichuan. He then followed Delengtai against Zhang Zicong at Huanglushan and Zhujiaping in Zhongjiang and killed or captured a great many rebels.

sentences.zh: 調四川松潘鎮，旋調廣東高廉鎮，仍留軍。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Songpan Garrison in Sichuan, then soon transferred to the Gaolian Garrison in Guangdong, remaining with the army nonetheless.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted to Songpan Garrison in Sichuan and then to Gaolian Garrison in Guangdong, but remained on active campaign duty.

sentences.zh: 夏，敗張子聰、庹向瑤於達州土主河，又擊劉朝選於七孔溪山，大破之。

translations.literal: In summer he defeated Zhang Zicong and Tuo Xiangyao at Tuzhu River in Dazhou, then attacked Liu Chaoxuan at Qikongxi Mountain and routed him.
translations.idiomatic: That summer he defeated Zhang Zicong and Tuo Xiangyao at Tuzhu River in Dazhou, then routed Liu Chaoxuan at Qikongxi Mountain.

sentences.zh: 追餘匪至大竹，遇苟文明屢夜來撲營，擊卻之。

translations.literal: Pursuing remnant rebels to Dazhu, he encountered Gou Wenming making repeated night assaults on his camp and repulsed him.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing remnant rebels to Dazhu, he drove off Gou Wenming when the latter repeatedly raided his camp by night.

sentences.zh: 八月，徐萬富竄房縣，追敗之兩河口。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Xu Wanfu fled to Fang County; he pursued and defeated him at Lianghekou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, when Xu Wanfu fled into Fang County, he pursued and defeated him at Lianghekou.

sentences.zh: 賊竄木瓜鋪，偪近遠安縣城，紹祖扼之牛鹿坡。

translations.literal: The rebels fled to Mugua Pu, pressing close to Yuan'an county seat; Shaozu blocked them at Niulupo.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels fled to Mugua Pu and threatened Yuan'an county seat, Shaozu blocked them at Niulupo.

sentences.zh: 賊分二隊，一犯縣城，一薄紹祖營。

translations.literal: The rebels split into two columns, one attacking the county seat and one pressing Shaozu's camp.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels divided into two columns, one striking the county seat and one closing on Shaozu's camp.

sentences.zh: 紹祖力拒，賊佯敗走，匹馬追之，遇伏被害。

translations.literal: Shaozu resisted with all his strength; the rebels feigned defeat and fled; he pursued alone on horseback, ran into an ambush, and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Shaozu fought them off, but when the rebels feigned retreat he pursued alone on horseback, walked into an ambush, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 依提督例賜卹，諡果壯，予騎都尉兼雲騎尉世職，子霖襲。

translations.literal: Posthumous honors were granted according to the precedent for provincial commanders-in-chief; he was given the posthumous title Guozhuang and hereditary ranks of Commandant of Cavalry and Ensign of the Cloud Cavalry Corps; his son Lin succeeded to the title.
translations.idiomatic: He received posthumous honors on the scale accorded a provincial commander-in-chief, with the posthumous title Guozhuang and hereditary ranks as Commandant of Cavalry and Ensign of the Cloud Cavalry Corps; his son Lin inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 宋延清，山東招遠人。

translations.literal: Song Yanqing was a native of Zhaoyuan in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Song Yanqing came from Zhaoyuan in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十六年武進士，授藍翎侍衛。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year of Qianlong he passed the military examinations and was appointed a Bodyguard of the Blue Feather.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the military examinations in Qianlong 46 and was appointed a Bodyguard of the Blue Feather.

sentences.zh: 出為貴州都司，遷游擊。

translations.literal: He left the capital to serve as battalion commander in Guizhou and was promoted to guerrilla colonel.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted to Guizhou as battalion commander and later promoted to guerrilla colonel.

sentences.zh: 從征苗疆，迭克峒寨。

translations.literal: Campaigning in the Miao frontier, he took dong villages in succession.
translations.idiomatic: On the Miao frontier campaigns he captured one dong stronghold after another.

sentences.zh: 從額勒登保攻鴨保山，率健卒奪賊卡，夜大風，攀崖縱火，克之，賜號蹻勇巴圖魯，擢參將。

translations.literal: Following Eledengbao in the attack on Yabao Mountain, he led crack troops to seize rebel stockades; at night a great wind blew; scaling the cliffs he set fire and captured it; he was granted the title Qiaoyong Baturu and promoted to brigade commander.
translations.idiomatic: With Eledengbao at Yabao Mountain he led elite troops to seize rebel stockades; that night, in a strong wind, his men scaled the cliffs and burned their way in. For this he received the title Qiaoyong Baturu and promotion to brigade commander.

sentences.zh: 仲苗之役，勒保調回貴州，率兵為左翼，克關嶺、碧峰山諸隘，破洞灑、當丈賊巢。

translations.literal: In the campaign against the Central Miao, Lebao recalled him to Guizhou; leading troops as the left wing, he captured passes at Guanling and Bifeng Mountain and broke the rebel nests at Dongsa and Dangzhang.
translations.idiomatic: During the Central Miao campaign Lebao recalled him to Guizhou, where he led the left wing, took the passes at Guanling and Bifeng Mountain, and broke the rebel strongholds at Dongsa and Dangzhang.

sentences.zh: 論功居最，擢大定協副將。

translations.literal: Judged foremost in merit, he was promoted to deputy commander of the Dading Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: Ranked first for merit, he was promoted to deputy commander of the Dading Brigade.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶三年，從勒保赴四川，擊賊董谿口、大元山，皆力戰，斬馘多。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jiaqing he followed Lebao to Sichuan, attacked rebels at Dongxikou and Dayuan Mountain, fought fiercely in each engagement, and killed or captured many.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 3 he followed Lebao into Sichuan, fought hard at Dongxikou and Dayuan Mountain, and killed or captured a great many rebels.

sentences.zh: 乘勝追賊至楊家壩，中槍，歿於陣。

translations.literal: Pressing the victory in pursuit to Yangjiaba, he was struck by a musket ball and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing the routed rebels to Yangjiaba, he was shot and killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 延清驍勇出眾，勒保常置左右。

translations.literal: Yanqing's fierce valor was outstanding; Lebao regularly kept him at his side.
translations.idiomatic: Yanqing was renowned for his fierce courage, and Lebao often kept him close at hand.

sentences.zh: 剿仲苗時，每戰歸，持刀負首級累累，衣盡赤，勒保輒手酌酒慰勞。

translations.literal: When suppressing the Central Miao, after each battle he would return carrying a knife and a string of heads, his clothes soaked red; Lebao would personally pour wine to reward him.
translations.idiomatic: During the Central Miao campaign he would return from each battle with sword in hand and heads slung across his back, his clothes drenched in blood; Lebao would personally pour wine to reward him.

sentences.zh: 至川未踰月即戰歿，深惜之，加等賜卹，予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: Having reached Sichuan less than a month before dying in battle, Lebao deeply regretted it, increased the posthumous honors, and granted a hereditary rank as Commandant of Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: He had been in Sichuan less than a month when he fell in battle; deeply regretting the loss, Lebao enhanced his posthumous honors and granted a hereditary rank as Commandant of Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 袁國璜，四川成都人。

translations.literal: Yuan Guohuang was a native of Chengdu in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Guohuang came from Chengdu in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 由行伍從征金川，屢克堅碉，擢守備。

translations.literal: Rising from the ranks, he campaigned in Jinchuan, repeatedly captured stubborn blockhouses, and was promoted to battalion defense commander.
translations.idiomatic: Rising through the ranks on the Jinchuan campaign, he repeatedly stormed fortified blockhouses and was promoted to battalion defense commander.

sentences.zh: 复革布什咱全境及達爾圖，功皆最，洊升游擊。

translations.literal: He recovered the whole territory of Gepa Bushan and Dartu; in merit he ranked foremost each time, and was repeatedly promoted to guerrilla colonel.
translations.idiomatic: He recovered all of Gepa Bushan and Dartu, ranked first for merit in each action, and was promoted in due course to guerrilla colonel.

sentences.zh: 金川平，擢江南狼山鎮總兵。

translations.literal: When Jinchuan was pacified, he was promoted to brigade general of Langshan Garrison in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: After the pacification of Jinchuan he was promoted to brigade general at Langshan Garrison in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十三年，從征台灣，克大埔尾、鬥六門、水沙連、大里杙，賜號博濟巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the fifty-third year of Qianlong he campaigned in Taiwan, captured Dabuwei, Douliumen, Shuishalian, and Dalicheng, and was granted the title Boji Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 53 he fought in Taiwan, taking Dabuwei, Douliumen, Shuishalian, and Dalicheng, and received the title Boji Baturu.

sentences.zh: 及林爽文竄匿東勢角，山徑深隘，徒步搜捕，生擒於老K8崎，被優敘。

translations.literal: When Lin Shuangwen fled and hid at Dongshijiao, where mountain paths were deep and narrow, he searched on foot and captured him alive at Laojuqi, and received preferential promotion.
translations.idiomatic: When Lin Shuangwen hid at Dongshijiao in terrain of steep, narrow mountain paths, he tracked him on foot and took him alive at Laojuqi, earning preferential promotion.

sentences.zh: 病歸，起署四川建昌鎮，尋授重慶鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Ill, he returned home; recalled, he acted as commander of Jianchang Garrison in Sichuan, and soon was appointed brigade general of Chongqing Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: After illness sent him home, he was recalled to act as commander of Jianchang Garrison in Sichuan and soon received appointment as brigade general at Chongqing Garrison.

sentences.zh: 從征廓爾喀，克象巴宗山、甲爾古拉卡。

translations.literal: Campaigning in Gorkha, he captured Xiangbazong Mountain and Jiaergula Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On the Gorkha campaign he took Xiangbazong Mountain and Jiaergula Pass.

sentences.zh: 台灣、廓爾喀兩次論功，再圖像紫光閣。

translations.literal: For merit assessed in the Taiwan and Gorkha campaigns twice, his portrait was again placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: Cited for merit in both the Taiwan and Gorkha campaigns, he was again honored with a portrait in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 六十年，從總督孫士毅由川境進剿苗疆，數有功，被褒賞。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year he followed Governor-General Sun Shiyi from the Sichuan frontier to advance against the Miao frontier, achieved merit on several occasions, and was commended and rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 60 he followed Governor-General Sun Shiyi from the Sichuan border against the Miao frontier, distinguished himself repeatedly, and received imperial commendation.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，四川教匪蜂起，蔓延數縣。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing sect rebels rose like hornets in Sichuan and spread across several counties.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 1 White Lotus sect rebels rose across Sichuan and spread through several counties.

sentences.zh: 川兵多赴苗疆，署總督英善倉猝偕副都統勒禮善、佛住馳往，兵僅數千，檄國璜及總兵何元卿進剿達州。

translations.literal: Most Sichuan troops had gone to the Miao frontier; Acting Governor-General Yingshan hastily galloped there with Deputy Lieutenant-General Le Lishan and Fozhu with only a few thousand men, and summoned Guohuang and Brigade General He Yuanqing to advance against Dazhou.
translations.idiomatic: Most Sichuan troops were on the Miao frontier when Acting Governor-General Yingshan rushed to the scene with Deputy Lieutenant-General Le Lishan and Fozhu at the head of only a few thousand men and ordered Guohuang and Brigade General He Yuanqing to advance on Dazhou.

sentences.zh: 賊屯天星橋，國璜奮擊，斬戮千餘。

translations.literal: The rebels held Tianxing Bridge; Guohuang attacked fiercely and killed more than a thousand.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels held Tianxing Bridge, Guohuang attacked fiercely and killed more than a thousand.

sentences.zh: 賊竄橫山子，偕元卿焚其卡，奪據山梁。

translations.literal: The rebels fled to Hengshanzi; together with Yuanqing he burned their stockades and seized the mountain ridge.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels fled to Hengshanzi, he and Yuanqing burned their stockades and took the ridge.

sentences.zh: 賊自東鄉糾黨數千來犯，砲擊之退，次日復聚，迎擊，斃賊數百，而來者愈眾。

translations.literal: Rebels from Dongxiang mustered several thousand partisans to attack; cannon fire drove them back; the next day they gathered again; meeting them in battle he killed several hundred rebels, but those coming grew ever more numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels from Dongxiang rallied several thousand men to attack; he drove them back with artillery, but they regrouped the next day. He met them in battle and killed several hundred, yet more kept coming.

sentences.zh: 國璜苦戰三日，力竭陣亡，依提督例賜卹，予騎都尉兼雲騎尉世職，子起襲。

translations.literal: Guohuang fought bitterly for three days, exhausted his strength, and died in battle; posthumous honors were granted according to the precedent for provincial commanders-in-chief; he was granted hereditary ranks as Commandant of Cavalry and Ensign of the Cloud Cavalry Corps; his son Qi succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Guohuang fought bitterly for three days until he was exhausted and killed in battle. He received posthumous honors on the scale accorded a provincial commander-in-chief, with hereditary ranks as Commandant of Cavalry and Ensign of the Cloud Cavalry Corps; his son Qi inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 何元卿，四川華陽人。

translations.literal: He Yuanqing was a native of Huayang in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: He Yuanqing came from Huayang in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 從征金川、廓爾喀、苗疆，積勞擢副將。

translations.literal: Campaigning in Jinchuan, Gorkha, and the Miao frontier, he accumulated merit through hardship and was promoted to brigade deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: Service on the Jinchuan, Gorkha, and Miao frontier campaigns earned him promotion to brigade deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，從福寧克旗鼓寨，擢陝西興漢鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he followed Funing in capturing Qibozhai and was promoted to brigade general of Xinghan Garrison in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 1 he followed Funing in taking Qibozhai and was promoted to brigade general at Xinghan Garrison in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 達州橫山子之戰，與國璜同遇害，予騎都尉兼雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: In the battle of Hengshanzi at Dazhou he met the same fate as Guohuang and was killed; he was granted hereditary ranks as Commandant of Cavalry and Ensign of the Cloud Cavalry Corps.
translations.idiomatic: He was killed alongside Guohuang at Hengshanzi in Dazhou and was granted hereditary ranks as Commandant of Cavalry and Ensign of the Cloud Cavalry Corps.

sentences.zh: 孫胜先襲，官至湖南沅州協副將。

translations.literal: His grandson Sheng succeeded to the title and rose to deputy commander of the Yuanzhou Brigade in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Sheng inherited the title and eventually rose to deputy commander of the Yuanzhou Brigade in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 諸神保，馬佳氏，滿洲正紅旗人。

translations.literal: Zhushenbao, of the Majia clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhushenbao, of the Majia clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 起護軍校，出為四川游擊，駐西藏，累擢重慶鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Starting as a guard company captain, he left the capital to serve as guerrilla colonel in Sichuan, was stationed in Tibet, and was repeatedly promoted to brigade general of Chongqing Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Starting as a guard company captain, he was posted to Sichuan as guerrilla colonel, served in Tibet, and rose to brigade general at Chongqing Garrison.

sentences.zh: 廓爾喀之役，守絨轄要隘，賞花翎。

translations.literal: In the Gorkha campaign he guarded the key pass at Rongxia and was awarded a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: During the Gorkha campaign he held the vital pass at Rongxia and was awarded a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 調建昌鎮，從征苗疆。

translations.literal: Transferred to Jianchang Garrison, he campaigned in the Miao frontier.
translations.idiomatic: After transfer to Jianchang Garrison he fought on the Miao frontier.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，赴湖北剿教匪，從福寧破賊來鳳，克旗鼓寨，賜號喀勒春巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he went to Hubei to suppress sect rebels, followed Funing in defeating rebels at Laifeng, captured Qibozhai, and was granted the title Kalechun Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 1 he went to Hubei against the sect rebels, followed Funing in breaking the rebels at Laifeng, took Qibozhai, and received the title Kalechun Baturu.

sentences.zh: 二年，從額勒登保圍攻芭葉山，賊夜突營，由諸神保汛地逸出，坐褫職，留營自贖。

translations.literal: In the second year he followed Eledengbao in besieging Baye Mountain; rebels broke out of camp by night and escaped through Zhushenbao's garrison sector; he was stripped of office for the offense and remained with the army to redeem himself.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 2, while besieging Baye Mountain with Eledengbao, he allowed rebels to break out by night through his sector; he was stripped of rank but kept with the army to redeem himself.

sentences.zh: 尋擊賊紅土溪，被創墜馬陣亡，依參將例賜卹，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: Soon after, attacking rebels at Hongtu Stream, he was wounded, fell from his horse, and died in battle; posthumous honors were granted according to the precedent for brigade commanders, and a hereditary rank as Ensign of the Cloud Cavalry Corps was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, fighting rebels at Hongtu Stream, he was wounded, fell from his horse, and died in battle. He received posthumous honors on the scale accorded a brigade commander and a hereditary rank as Ensign of the Cloud Cavalry Corps.

sentences.zh: 達三泰，原名達音泰，呢瑪奇氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Dasan'tai, original name Dayintai, of the Nimachi clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Dasan'tai, originally named Dayintai, of the Nimachi clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 由鳥槍藍翎長累遷副護軍參領。

translations.literal: Starting as a musket corps blue-feather squad leader, he was repeatedly promoted to deputy guard battalion colonel.
translations.idiomatic: Starting as a blue-feather musket squad leader, he rose in due course to deputy guard battalion colonel.

sentences.zh: 從征石峰堡，授陝西循化營參將。

translations.literal: Campaigning at Shifeng Fort, he was appointed brigade commander of the Xunhua Battalion in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the Shifeng Fort campaign he was appointed brigade commander of the Xunhua Battalion in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 歷甘肅永固協副將，署西寧鎮。

translations.literal: He served successively as deputy commander of the Yonggu Brigade in Gansu and acting commander of Xining Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: He served as deputy commander of the Yonggu Brigade in Gansu and later acted as commander of Xining Garrison.

sentences.zh: 從征廓爾喀有功，賜號常勇巴圖魯，授四川松潘鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Campaigning in Gorkha with merit, he was granted the title Changyong Baturu and appointed brigade general of Songpan Garrison in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: For service on the Gorkha campaign he received the title Changyong Baturu and appointment as brigade general at Songpan Garrison in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆六十年，湖南苗犯酉陽，率屯土兵擊之，克砲木山、石花諸寨。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year of Qianlong Miao from Hunan invaded Youyang; leading local garrison and tribal troops he attacked them and captured stockades at Paomushan, Shihua, and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 60, when Hunan Miao raided Youyang, he led local garrison and native levies against them and took the stockades at Paomushan, Shihua, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 偕提督花連布進解永綏圍，又偕阿哈保、塞靈額攻納共山，攀縋而上，斬獲甚眾。

translations.literal: Together with Provincial Commander-in-Chief Hua Lianbu he advanced to lift the siege of Yongshun; again with Ah Bao and Sailinge he attacked Nagong Mountain, climbed by rope, and killed or captured many.
translations.idiomatic: With Provincial Commander-in-Chief Hua Lianbu he relieved the siege of Yongshun, then with Ah Bao and Sailinge assaulted Nagong Mountain by rope-climbing and killed or captured a great many.

sentences.zh: 克貴道嶺、馬鞍山，追賊黃土坡，被創力戰，大捷，特賜蟒服。

translations.literal: He captured Guidao Ridge and Ma'an Mountain, pursued rebels to Huangtu Slope, was wounded yet fought on for a great victory, and was specially granted a python robe.
translations.idiomatic: He took Guidao Ridge and Ma'an Mountain, pursued the rebels to Huangtu Slope, fought on though wounded for a great victory, and was specially granted a python robe.

sentences.zh: 又破貫魚坡，苗疆平。

translations.literal: He again broke Guangyu Slope and the Miao frontier was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: After he broke Guangyu Slope the Miao frontier was pacified.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，移軍湖北剿教匪，遂赴四川。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing he shifted troops to Hubei to suppress sect rebels and then proceeded to Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 2 he moved his forces to Hubei against the sect rebels and then into Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 齊王氏、姚之富趨達州，欲與王三槐等合，達三泰先據白帝城，連戰卻之，進援巫山、巴東，要擊之小河口，又追敗之均州、竹溪。

translations.literal: Qi Wangshi and Yao Zhifu advanced toward Dazhou intending to join Wang Sanhuai and others; Dasan'tai first seized Baidi City, repulsed them in successive battles, advanced to reinforce Wushan and Badong, intercepted them at Xiaohekou, and again pursued and defeated them at Junzhou and Zhuxi.
translations.idiomatic: When Qi Wangshi and Yao Zhifu moved on Dazhou to join Wang Sanhuai and others, Dasan'tai seized Baidi City first, beat them back in repeated fights, reinforced Wushan and Badong, intercepted them at Xiaohekou, and pursued them to defeat at Junzhou and Zhuxi.

sentences.zh: 賊復由陝入川，與明亮合擊於黃壩驛。

translations.literal: The rebels again entered Sichuan from Shaanxi; he joined Mingliang in a combined attack at Huangba Post.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels re-entered Sichuan from Shaanxi, he joined Mingliang in a combined strike at Huangba Post.

sentences.zh: 三年，從大軍逼賊三岔河，齊、王二賊就殲，被優賚。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed the main army in pressing rebels at Sancha River; the two rebel leaders Qi and Wang were destroyed; he received special rewards.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 3 he followed the main force against the rebels at Sancha River; the rebel leaders Qi and Wang were destroyed, and he received special rewards.

sentences.zh: 尋擊高均德於山陽，合圍大神山，設伏誘賊，敗之靜邊寺，擒斬甚眾。

translations.literal: Soon after he attacked Gao Junde at Shanyang, jointly encircled Dashen Mountain, set an ambush to lure the rebels, defeated them at Jingbian Temple, and captured and killed many.
translations.idiomatic: He next struck Gao Junde at Shanyang, joined the encirclement of Dashen Mountain, lured the rebels into ambush, routed them at Jingbian Temple, and killed or captured many.

sentences.zh: 會諸軍克箕山，擢甘肅提督。

translations.literal: When allied armies captured Jishan, he was promoted to provincial commander-in-chief of Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: After allied forces took Jishan he was promoted to provincial commander-in-chief of Gansu.

sentences.zh: 勒保調赴川東助剿冷天祿，攻手把岩，奪魚鱗口賊卡，遇伏被害。

translations.literal: Lebao transferred him to eastern Sichuan to assist in suppressing Leng Tianlu; attacking Shouba Rock he seized rebel stockades at Yulin Pass, ran into an ambush, and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Lebao sent him to eastern Sichuan against Leng Tianlu; storming Shouba Rock he took the rebel stockades at Yulin Pass but walked into an ambush and was killed.

sentences.zh: 優恤，諡壯節，予騎都尉兼雲騎尉世職，子呢瑪善襲。

translations.literal: Exceptional posthumous honors were granted; he was given the posthumous title Zhuangjie and hereditary ranks as Commandant of Cavalry and Ensign of the Cloud Cavalry Corps; his son Nimashan succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: He received exceptional posthumous honors, the posthumous title Zhuangjie, and hereditary ranks as Commandant of Cavalry and Ensign of the Cloud Cavalry Corps; his son Nimashan inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 呢瑪善從父軍中，以戰功授藍翎侍衛。

translations.literal: Nimashan followed his father in the army and, for military merit, was appointed a Bodyguard of the Blue Feather.
translations.idiomatic: Nimashan campaigned with his father and, for merit in battle, was appointed a Bodyguard of the Blue Feather.

sentences.zh: 父歿，轉戰三省，累擢頭等侍衛，授河北鎮總兵，歷鄖、衢州、南陽諸鎮。

translations.literal: After his father's death he fought across three provinces, was repeatedly promoted to first-class bodyguard, appointed brigade general of Hebei Garrison, and served successively at Yun, Quzhou, and Nanyang garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: After his father's death he fought across three provinces, rose to first-class bodyguard, became brigade general at Hebei Garrison, and later commanded the garrisons at Yun, Quzhou, and Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 道光初，擢成都將軍，平果洛克番匪。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Daoguang he was promoted to Military Governor of Chengdu and pacified the Guoluo Tibetan bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Daoguang reign he was promoted to Military Governor of Chengdu and pacified the Guoluo Tibetan bandits.

sentences.zh: 卒，諡勤襄。

translations.literal: He died and was given the posthumous title Qinxiang.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously titled Qinxiang.

sentences.zh: 德齡，納喇氏，滿洲鑲白旗人。

translations.literal: Deling, of the Nara clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Deling, of the Nara clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 由拜唐阿累擢鑾輿衛冠軍使。

translations.literal: Starting as a baitang'a, he was repeatedly promoted to champion officer of the Imperial Procession Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Starting as a baitang'a, he rose to champion officer of the Imperial Procession Guard.

sentences.zh: 出為直隸副將，擢山西太原鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Leaving the capital he served as brigade deputy commander in Zhili and was promoted to brigade general of Taiyuan Garrison in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted to Zhili as brigade deputy commander and promoted to brigade general at Taiyuan Garrison in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 調赴襄陽剿教匪，從慶成等轉戰，以功賜花翎。

translations.literal: Transferred to Xiangyang to suppress sect rebels, he campaigned in turn with Qing Cheng and others; for merit he was granted a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: Sent to Xiangyang against the sect rebels, he fought alongside Qing Cheng and others and was awarded a peacock feather for merit.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，駐防夔州。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing he garrisoned Kuizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 2 he garrisoned Kuizhou.

sentences.zh: 三年，偕觀成合攻老木園。

translations.literal: In the third year he joined Guan Cheng in a combined attack on Laomuyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 3 he joined Guan Cheng in a combined assault on Laomuyuan.

sentences.zh: 賊既殲，剿鐵瓦寺餘匪。

translations.literal: Once the rebels were destroyed, he suppressed remnant bandits at Tiewa Temple.
translations.idiomatic: After the main rebel force was destroyed, he mopped up remnant bandits at Tiewa Temple.

sentences.zh: 四年秋，擊張金魁於岳池場、安家山，敗之。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the fourth year he attacked Zhang Jinkui at Yuechi Field and Anjia Mountain and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of Jiaqing 4 he defeated Zhang Jinkui at Yuechi Field and Anjia Mountain.

sentences.zh: 追至萬縣陳家坡，後隊為賊所襲，馳馬回戰，歿於陣，予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: Pursuing to Chenjiapo in Wan County, his rear column was attacked by rebels; he galloped back to fight and died in battle; a hereditary rank as Commandant of Cavalry was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing to Chenjiapo in Wan County, he turned back when his rear column was ambushed and died in the fight; a hereditary rank as Commandant of Cavalry was granted.

sentences.zh: 保興，承吉氏，滿洲鑲白旗人。

translations.literal: Baoxing, of the Chengji clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Baoxing, of the Chengji clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 鳥槍護軍隊長。

translations.literal: He was a musket guard squad leader.
translations.idiomatic: He served as a musket guard squad leader.

sentences.zh: 從征緬甸、金川，累遷參領。

translations.literal: Campaigning in Burma and Jinchuan, he was repeatedly promoted to guard battalion colonel.
translations.idiomatic: On the Burma and Jinchuan campaigns he rose to guard battalion colonel.

sentences.zh: 出為陝西神木協副將，丁憂回旗。

translations.literal: Leaving the capital he served as deputy commander of the Shenmu Brigade in Shaanxi; upon mourning for his father he returned to his banner.
translations.idiomatic: Posted to Shaanxi as deputy commander of the Shenmu Brigade, he returned to his banner on bereavement leave.

sentences.zh: 甘肅撒拉爾回叛，起署河州協。

translations.literal: When Salar Muslims rebelled in Gansu, he was recalled to act as deputy commander of the Hezhou Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: When the Salar Muslims rebelled in Gansu, he was recalled to act as deputy commander of the Hezhou Brigade.

sentences.zh: 兵事初定，撫綏有法，軍民安之。

translations.literal: When hostilities first settled, his pacification and comfort were well ordered, and soldiers and civilians were at peace.
translations.idiomatic: Once fighting subsided, he governed with effective pacification measures and won the confidence of both troops and civilians.

sentences.zh: 調督標中軍，擢直隸宣化鎮總兵，歷陝西興漢鎮、甘肅河州鎮。

translations.literal: Transferred to central battalion of the governor-general's banner, he was promoted to brigade general of Xuanhua Garrison in Zhili and served successively at Xinghan Garrison in Shaanxi and Hezhou Garrison in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: After transfer to the governor-general's central battalion he became brigade general at Xuanhua Garrison in Zhili and later commanded Xinghan Garrison in Shaanxi and Hezhou Garrison in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，赴川、陝剿教匪。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing he went to Sichuan and Shaanxi to suppress sect rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 2 he went to Sichuan and Shaanxi against the sect rebels.

sentences.zh: 偕硃射鬥擊賊營山，又敗之小埡口。

translations.literal: Together with Zhu Shedou he attacked rebels at Yingshan and again defeated them at Xiaoyakou.
translations.idiomatic: With Zhu Shedou he attacked the rebels at Yingshan and again defeated them at Xiaoyakou.

sentences.zh: 王三槐擾大竹、廣安，要擊之。

translations.literal: Wang Sanhuai harassed Dazhu and Guang'an; he intercepted them.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Sanhuai harassed Dazhu and Guang'an, he intercepted them.

sentences.zh: 鄰水被圍，知縣楊為龍堅守，馳援，賊始退，被優賚，偕硃射鬥破賊天華山，乘勝連奪要隘。

translations.literal: Linshui was besieged; Magistrate Yang Weilong held firm; he galloped to reinforce and the rebels only then withdrew; he received special rewards; together with Zhu Shedou he broke rebels at Tianhua Mountain and, pressing the victory, seized key passes in succession.
translations.idiomatic: When Linshui was besieged and Magistrate Yang Weilong held out, he rushed to reinforce and drove the rebels off, earning special rewards; with Zhu Shedou he broke the rebels at Tianhua Mountain and, pressing the victory, took one vital pass after another.

sentences.zh: 三年，攻彈子壩，殲賊渠。

translations.literal: In the third year he attacked Danziba and destroyed the rebel chieftain.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 3 he assaulted Danziba and killed the rebel leader.

sentences.zh: 時王三槐犯開縣，羅其清、冉文儔合踞東鄉後河，將窺陝。

translations.literal: At that time Wang Sanhuai invaded Kaixian; Luo Qiqing and Ran Wenfu jointly held Dongxiang Houhe and were about to menace Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Wang Sanhuai struck Kaixian while Luo Qiqing and Ran Wenfu held Dongxiang Houhe together and threatened to move into Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 保興繞出賊前，與楊秀夾擊，敗賊於固軍壩，賞花翎。

translations.literal: Baoxing swung around ahead of the rebels and, together with Yang Xiu, attacked from both sides, defeating them at Gujunba, and was awarded a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: Baoxing swung around in front of the rebels and, with Yang Xiu attacking from the other side, routed them at Gujunba and was awarded a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 賊自陝回擾達州，保興要擊於龍鳳埡。

translations.literal: Rebels returning from Shaanxi again harassed Dazhou; Baoxing intercepted them at Longfengya.
translations.idiomatic: When rebels returning from Shaanxi again raided Dazhou, Baoxing intercepted them at Longfengya.

sentences.zh: 又戰石梯坎，徑路紛歧，會大風雨，賊壓而陣，遂遇害。

translations.literal: Again fighting at Shitikan, where paths branched in confusion, a great wind and rain arose; the rebels pressed forward in battle formation and he met his death.
translations.idiomatic: Fighting again at Shitikan, where the paths forked chaotically, he was caught in a storm as the rebels closed in battle formation and was killed.

sentences.zh: 予騎都尉世職，河州民為立祠。

translations.literal: A hereditary rank as Commandant of Cavalry was granted, and the people of Hezhou built a shrine for him.
translations.idiomatic: A hereditary rank as Commandant of Cavalry was granted, and the people of Hezhou erected a shrine in his honor.

sentences.zh: 凝德，烏雅氏，滿洲正黃旗人，尚書官保子。

translations.literal: Ningde, of the Uya clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner and son of Minister Guanbao.
translations.idiomatic: Ningde, of the Uya clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner and the son of Minister Guanbao.

sentences.zh: 授藍翎侍衛，歷鑾輿衛治儀正、冠軍使。

translations.literal: Appointed a Bodyguard of the Blue Feather, he served successively as director of ceremonies and champion officer of the Imperial Procession Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed a Bodyguard of the Blue Feather, he rose through the ranks of the Imperial Procession Guard to director of ceremonies and champion officer.

sentences.zh: 出為直隸獨石口副將，謂督標中軍。

translations.literal: Leaving the capital he served as brigade deputy commander at Dushikou in Zhili and was appointed to the governor-general's central battalion.
translations.idiomatic: Posted to Dushikou in Zhili as brigade deputy commander, he was appointed to the governor-general's central battalion.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，赴湖北軍，從破黃玉貴於紅土山，賞花翎。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he joined the army in Hubei, followed in defeating Huang Yugui at Hongtu Mountain, and was awarded a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 1 he joined the Hubei campaign, helped defeat Huang Yugui at Hongtu Mountain, and was awarded a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 二年，赴孤山沖防剿，尋入川。

translations.literal: In the second year he went to Gushan Chong for garrison defense and suppression, and soon entered Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 2 he was posted to Gushan Chong for garrison and mop-up operations, then entered Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 王三槐擾渠縣，扼守紅春壩。

translations.literal: Wang Sanhuai harassed Quxian and held fast at Hongchun Dam.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Sanhuai raided Quxian and entrenched himself at Hongchun Dam.

sentences.zh: 四年，擢甘肅巴里坤總兵。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was promoted to brigade general of Barkul in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 4 he was promoted to brigade general at Barkul in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 從恆瑞勦賊甘肅，駐守三曹河。

translations.literal: Following Heng Rui he suppressed rebels in Gansu and garrisoned at Sancao River.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Heng Rui in suppressing rebels in Gansu and was posted at Sancao River.

sentences.zh: 賊北走，追敗之老柏樹、牟家壩、兩河口。

translations.literal: The rebels fled north; he pursued and defeated them at Laobaishu, Moujiaba, and Lianghekou.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels fled north, he pursued and routed them at Laobaishu, Moujiaba, and Lianghekou.

sentences.zh: 五年，辛聰餘黨竄秦安，訛言伏羌被圍，凝德率兵四百赴援，未至四十里遇賊，眾寡不敵，拒戰被害。

translations.literal: In the fifth year remnants of Xin Cong fled into Qin'an; a false report spread that Fuxiang was besieged. Ningde led four hundred men to the relief, and when still forty li short he met the rebels; outnumbered, he resisted in battle and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 5 remnants of Xin Cong's band slipped into Qin'an, and a rumor that Fuxiang was under siege sent Ningde rushing forth with four hundred men. Still forty li from his goal he ran into the rebels; badly outnumbered, he stood and fought and was killed.

sentences.zh: 予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: A hereditary rank as Commandant of Cavalry was granted.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted a hereditary rank as Commandant of Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 多爾濟扎布，巴魯特氏，蒙古鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Duoerji Zhabu, of the Barut clan, was a Mongol of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Duoerji Zhabu, of the Barut clan, was a Mongol bannerman of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 由藍翎侍衛累擢湖北鄖陽參將。

translations.literal: From Bodyguard of the Blue Feather he was repeatedly promoted to assistant brigade commander at Yunyang in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: Starting as a Bodyguard of the Blue Feather, he rose by stages to assistant brigade commander at Yunyang in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 從剿鎮筸苗，遷副將。

translations.literal: Following the campaign against the Miao at Zhengan, he was transferred to brigade deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: On the Zhengan Miao campaign he was promoted to brigade deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，檄防竹山、竹谿。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he was ordered to defend Zhushan and Zhuxi.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 1 he was ordered to defend Zhushan and Zhuxi.

sentences.zh: 三年，署宜昌鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the third year he acted as brigade general of Yichang Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 3 he served as acting brigade general at Yichang Garrison.

sentences.zh: 從擊張漢潮於山中，躡踪窮追，被嘉獎。

translations.literal: Following an attack on Zhang Hanchao in the mountains, he tracked and pursued to the end and received imperial commendation.
translations.idiomatic: He pursued Zhang Hanchao relentlessly through the mountains and received imperial commendation.

sentences.zh: 五年，授廣東碣石鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed brigade general of Jieshi Garrison in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 5 he was appointed brigade general at Jieshi Garrison in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 二月，剿陝匪於洵陽三岔山，乘勝深入，賊分隊繞襲後路，四面受敵，揮軍殺賊百餘，日暮力盡，被害。

translations.literal: In the second month he suppressed Shaanxi rebels at Sanchashan in Xunyang; pressing his advantage deep inside, the rebels divided into groups and circled to strike his rear. Attacked on all sides, he led his troops in killing more than a hundred rebels, but by nightfall his strength was spent and he was killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month he fought Shaanxi rebels at Sanchashan in Xunyang and drove deep behind their lines. The rebels split into columns and swung around to hit his rear; beset on every side, he still cut down more than a hundred of the enemy before dusk found his men exhausted and he fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: A hereditary rank as Commandant of Cavalry was granted.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted a hereditary rank as Commandant of Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 王凱，貴州貴築人。

translations.literal: Wang Kai was a native of Guizhu in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Kai came from Guizhu in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 從征金川，積勞至游擊，累擢浙江定海鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Campaigning in Jinchuan, he accumulated service until guerrilla colonel and was repeatedly promoted to brigade general of Dinghai Garrison in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the Jinchuan campaign he worked his way up to guerrilla colonel and was eventually promoted to brigade general at Dinghai Garrison in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，以不諳水師降副將，命赴貴州從勒保剿仲苗，補都勻協。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing, because he was unversed in naval warfare he was reduced to brigade deputy commander and ordered to Guizhou to follow Le Bao in suppressing the Central Miao, filling a vacancy in the Duyun Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 2 his unfamiliarity with naval operations cost him a rank—he was reduced to brigade deputy commander and sent to Guizhou to follow Le Bao against the Central Miao, filling a post in the Duyun Brigade.

sentences.zh: 三年，授宜昌鎮總兵，駐守鄖縣，敗賊於黃龍灘。

translations.literal: In the third year he was appointed brigade general of Yichang Garrison, garrisoned at Yunxian, and defeated rebels at Huanglongtan.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 3 he was made brigade general at Yichang Garrison, posted to Yunxian, and routed rebels at Huanglongtan.

sentences.zh: 率兵二千，分守鄖西、巴州，防張漢潮。

translations.literal: Leading two thousand men, he divided his forces to guard Yuxi and Bazhou against Zhang Hanchao.
translations.idiomatic: With two thousand men under his command he split his forces between Yuxi and Bazhou to block Zhang Hanchao.

sentences.zh: 四年，賊竄房縣，擊走之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year rebels fled into Fangxian; he attacked and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 4 rebels broke into Fangxian; he attacked and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 五年，復來犯，大敗其眾，又破賊於東湖。

translations.literal: In the fifth year they invaded again; he routed their main force and again defeated rebels at Donghu.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 5 they came again; he crushed their main body and then beat them again at Donghu.

sentences.zh: 夏，徐天德窺襄、鄖兵單，犯當陽、遠安，踞馬鞍山，合諸軍環攻，凱傍左麓進，賊走馬家營。

translations.literal: In summer Xu Tiande, seeing that Xiangyang and Yunzhou were thinly garrisoned, invaded Dangyang and Yuan'an and occupied Ma'anshan. The combined armies surrounded and attacked; Kai advanced along the left foothills and the rebels fled to Majiaying.
translations.idiomatic: That summer Xu Tiande, noticing how lightly Xiangyang and Yunzhou were held, struck at Dangyang and Yuan'an and seized Ma'anshan. When allied columns closed in from every side, Kai advanced along the left slope and the rebels withdrew to Majiaying.

sentences.zh: 師分三路入，賊張左右翼拒戰，別遣步隊鈔截後路，凱奮擊，賊稍卻，兵進遇伏，賊自林中出，猝被害。

translations.literal: The army divided into three routes to enter; the rebels spread left and right wings to resist, while separately sending infantry to cut off the rear. Kai fought fiercely and the rebels drew back slightly, but as the troops advanced they met an ambush; rebels burst from the forest and he was suddenly killed.
translations.idiomatic: The army entered in three columns while the rebels spread their wings to block the advance and sent foot soldiers to cut the rear. Kai pressed hard and the enemy gave ground—then his men walked into an ambush. Rebels sprang from the forest and he was cut down without warning.

sentences.zh: 優恤，諡勇壯，予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: He received enhanced posthumous honors, was given the posthumous title Yongzhuang, and granted a hereditary rank as Commandant of Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: The court granted him enhanced posthumous honors, the posthumous title Yongzhuang, and a hereditary rank as Commandant of Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 王懋賞，山東福山人。

translations.literal: Wang Maoshang was a native of Fushan in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Maoshang came from Fushan in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十一年一甲一名武進士，授頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year of Qianlong he took first place among first-rank military graduates and was appointed a First-Class Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 41 he finished first among the top military graduates and was appointed a First-Class Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 出為雲南景蒙營游擊，累遷廣西潯州協副將。

translations.literal: Leaving the capital he served as guerrilla colonel at Jingmeng Camp in Yunnan and was repeatedly transferred until brigade deputy commander of the Xunzhou Brigade in Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Posted to Jingmeng Camp in Yunnan as guerrilla colonel, he rose through successive transfers to brigade deputy commander of the Xunzhou Brigade in Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 從征苗疆，克結石岡，破尖雲山，复乾州，皆有功。

translations.literal: Campaigning in the Miao frontier, he captured Jieshigang, broke through Jianyun Mountain, and recovered Qianzhou—meriting credit in each action.
translations.idiomatic: On the Miao frontier campaign he took Jieshigang, stormed Jianyun Mountain, and recovered Qianzhou, distinguishing himself in each.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，以剿西隆匪，回廣西。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing, after suppressing rebels in Xilong, he returned to Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 2, after suppressing rebels at Xilong, he returned to Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 五年，調赴湖北軍。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to the army in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 5 he was transferred to the Hubei front.

sentences.zh: 六年，敗賊佘家河、茅倫山，賞花翎。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he defeated rebels at Shejiahe and Maolunshan and was awarded a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 6 he routed rebels at Shejiahe and Maolunshan and received a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 攻鵝坪坡、秦家坪，擢湖南永州鎮總兵，駐守興州、房縣、大竹，防川、陝竄賊。

translations.literal: Attacking Epinpo and Qinjiapin, he was promoted to brigade general of Yongzhou Garrison in Hunan and garrisoned Xingzhou, Fangxian, and Dazhu to guard against rebels raiding from Sichuan and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: After assaults on Epinpo and Qinjiapin he was promoted to brigade general at Yongzhou Garrison in Hunan and posted across Xingzhou, Fangxian, and Dazhu to block rebels slipping in from Sichuan and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 七年，曾家秀等竄保康，倍道窮追，賊踞馬鬃嶺拒戰，懋賞先登，中矛，歿於陣。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Zeng Jiaxiu and others fled into Baokang; he forced a rapid pursuit, and when the rebels held Mazongling to resist, Maoshang was first to scale the heights, was struck by a spear, and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 7, when Zeng Jiaxiu and others broke into Baokang, he forced the pace of pursuit. The rebels made their stand on Mazongling; Maoshang was first over the crest, took a spear thrust, and fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: A hereditary rank as Commandant of Cavalry was granted.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted a hereditary rank as Commandant of Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 惠倫，富察氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人，一等承恩公奎林子。

translations.literal: Huilun, of the Fuca clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner and son of First-class Cheng'en Duke Kuilin.
translations.idiomatic: Huilun, of the Fuca clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner and the son of First-class Cheng'en Duke Kuilin.

sentences.zh: 出嗣伯父一等誠嘉毅勇公明瑞，襲爵，擢頭等侍衛、尚茶正、鑲藍旗護軍統領，授奉宸苑卿。

translations.literal: He left the capital to succeed his paternal uncle, First-class Chengjia Yonggong Mingrui, inherited the dukedom, was promoted to First-Class Bodyguard, director of tea service, commander of the Bordered Blue Banner Guard, and appointed superintendent of the Imperial Parks.
translations.idiomatic: Posted out of the capital, he succeeded his uncle, First-class Chengjia Yonggong Mingrui, inherited the ducal title, and rose through First-Class Bodyguard, director of tea service, and commander of the Bordered Blue Banner Guard to superintendent of the Imperial Parks.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，命偕副都統阿哈保率東三省兵赴湖北剿教匪，時賊氛方熾，詔惠倫迅往襄陽，如明亮、德楞泰猶在賊後，即會同王文雄攻剿，聽景安調度。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing he was ordered, together with Deputy Lieutenant-General Ahabao, to lead troops from the Three Eastern Provinces to Hubei to suppress sect rebels. Rebel strength was then at its height; the throne ordered Huilun to hurry to Xiangyang—if Mingliang and Delinge were still behind the rebels, he was to join Wang Wenxiong in attack and suppression, under Jing An's command.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 2 he and Deputy Lieutenant-General Ahabao were ordered to lead Northeastern banner troops to Hubei against the sect rebels. With rebel power at its height, the emperor commanded Huilun to race to Xiangyang: if Mingliang and Delinge were still trailing the enemy, he was to join Wang Wenxiong in the fight under Jing An's direction.

sentences.zh: 惠倫至襄陽，擊賊小河口，偕阿哈保追殺二十餘裡。

translations.literal: When Huilun reached Xiangyang he struck the rebels at Xiaohekou and, with Ahabao, pursued and killed them for more than twenty li.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Xiangyang, he hit the rebels at Xiaohekou and, with Ahabao, chased them more than twenty li, killing as they went.

sentences.zh: 大兵適自荊州至，乘機夾擊，賊大敗，竄入南漳山中，優詔獎賚。

translations.literal: The main army happened to arrive from Jingzhou; seizing the moment they attacked from both sides and the rebels were badly defeated, fleeing into the mountains of Nanzhang. An imperial edict commended and rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: Main-force columns arriving just then from Jingzhou, he seized the chance for a pincer attack and routed the rebels, who fled into the Nanzhang hills. An imperial edict singled him out for reward.

sentences.zh: 又偕德楞泰擊賊耗子溝，賊眾猛撲，達三泰連射賊，惠倫揮軍突進，衝入賊陣，會明亮自楓樹埡夾攻，斬獲甚多。

translations.literal: Again, with Delinge he attacked the rebels at Haozigou; the rebel host rushed fiercely forward. Dasan Tai shot repeatedly at the rebels; Huilun waved his army forward in a charge straight into the rebel formation. Mingliang joined from Fengshu Pass in a flanking attack, and many were killed or captured.
translations.idiomatic: With Delinge he struck again at Haozigou. As the rebel masses surged forward, Dasan Tai emptied his bow into their ranks while Huilun drove his men in a headlong charge. Mingliang came in from Fengshu Pass on the flank, and the slaughter was heavy.

sentences.zh: 賊竄花石嶺，總兵長春誘之下山，達三泰設伏山半，惠倫以勁騎橫擊。

translations.literal: The rebels fled to Huashiling; Brigade General Changchun lured them down the mountain, Dasan Tai set an ambush halfway up, and Huilun struck them horizontally with crack cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels withdrew to Huashiling. Changchun drew them down from the heights, Dasan Tai laid an ambush halfway up the slope, and Huilun hit them with a cavalry charge across their line.

sentences.zh: 賊敗竄黃龍灘，欲分走鄖陽鬥河，無船可渡。

translations.literal: Defeated, the rebels fled to Huanglongtan; wishing to divide and escape toward Douhe in Yunyang, they found no boats to cross.
translations.idiomatic: Beaten again, they broke for Huanglongtan and tried to split off toward Douhe in Yunyang—but there were no boats to carry them across.

sentences.zh: 追及草甸，賊五路迎拒，官軍亦分五隊，明亮等據山梁，賊上撲，擊敗之。

translations.literal: Pursuing them to Caodian, the rebels met the attack in five routes while the government troops also divided into five columns. Mingliang and others held the mountain ridge; the rebels charged uphill and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Caught at Caodian, the rebels formed five lines of defense; the imperial troops answered in five columns. Mingliang and his officers held the ridge, beat back the uphill rush, and broke the rebel formation.

sentences.zh: 別賊突出援，惠倫等又敗之。

translations.literal: Separate rebel forces rushed out to reinforce them; Huilun and the others defeated them again.
translations.idiomatic: Fresh rebel bands rushed up in support; Huilun and his officers routed them as well.

sentences.zh: 乃奔陳家山梁，乘霧圖遁。

translations.literal: They then fled to Chenjiashanliang, hoping to escape under cover of fog.
translations.idiomatic: They fled next to Chenjiashanliang, trying to slip away in the fog.

sentences.zh: 惠倫渡澗追擊，見一賊執旗指揮，知為渠魁，追至長坪，射之，應弦倒；

translations.literal: Huilun crossed a stream in pursuit; seeing a rebel holding a banner and directing operations, he knew this was the ringleader. Pursuing to Changping, he shot him and the man fell at the bowstring's release;
translations.idiomatic: Huilun crossed a ravine in pursuit and spotted a flag-bearer directing the fight—the rebel chief. He chased him to Changping, loosed an arrow, and the man dropped on the spot;

sentences.zh: 餘賊競集，連射斃數賊，猝中槍，歿於陣。

translations.literal: the remaining rebels crowded in; he shot and killed several in succession, then was suddenly struck by a musket and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: the rest swarmed around him. He dropped several with his bow, then took a musket ball and fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 仁宗震悼，詔惠倫父子效命疆場，實為可憫，從優議卹，賜內帑三千兩治喪，以子博啟圖襲公爵，在御前侍衛行走。

translations.literal: The Jiaqing Emperor was deeply shaken with grief and issued an edict: the father and son Huilun had given their lives on the frontier and truly deserved pity; enhanced posthumous honors were granted, three thousand taels from the privy purse were given for funeral expenses, and his son Boqitu inherited the ducal title and served as an imperial bodyguard attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Deeply shaken, the Jiaqing Emperor issued an edict lamenting that father and son had given their lives on the frontier—a loss truly to be mourned. The court granted enhanced posthumous honors, three thousand taels from the privy purse for the funeral, and the ducal title to his son Boqitu, who was appointed to serve as an imperial bodyguard attendant.

sentences.zh: 博啟圖自有傳。

translations.literal: Boqitu has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: Boqitu is the subject of a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 安祿，多拉爾氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人，一等超勇公海蘭察子。

translations.literal: An Lu, of the Dolar clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner and son of First-class Chaoyong Duke Hailancha.
translations.idiomatic: An Lu, of the Dolar clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner and the son of First-class Chaoyong Duke Hailancha.

sentences.zh: 以海蘭察平石峰堡功，推恩授二等侍衛、乾清門行走，並予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: Because of Hailancha's merit in pacifying Shifeng Fortress, favor was extended to grant him a Second-Class Bodyguard posting at the Gate of Heavenly Purity and a hereditary rank as Commandant of Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Through Hailancha's merit in pacifying Shifeng Fortress, imperial favor extended to An Lu: a Second-Class Bodyguard posting at the Gate of Heavenly Purity and a hereditary rank as Commandant of Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 從征廓爾喀，賜號哈什巴巴圖魯。

translations.literal: Campaigning in Gorkha, he was granted the honorific title Hashibaba Tuerlu.
translations.idiomatic: On the Gorkha campaign he received the honorific title Hashibaba Tuerlu.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十八年，承襲公爵，擢頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: In the fifty-eighth year of Qianlong he inherited the dukedom and was promoted to First-Class Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 58 he succeeded to the ducal title and was promoted to First-Class Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年，命解餉赴四川，遂從額勒登保軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing he was ordered to transport pay to Sichuan and then followed Eledengbao's army.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 4 he was ordered to escort supplies to Sichuan and joined Eledengbao's command.

sentences.zh: 時徐天德敗竄雞公梁，額勒登保乘夜追之，黎明，賊复拒戰，安祿偕格布舍以左翼衝賊陣，賊竄城隍廟，右翼楊遇春伏起，前後夾擊，殲戮無算。

translations.literal: At that time Xu Tiande, defeated, fled to Jigongliang; Eledengbao pursued by night, and at dawn the rebels again resisted. An Lu, with Gebushe, charged the rebel line with the left wing; the rebels fled to Chenghuang Temple, while on the right Yang Yuchun rose from ambush—a pincer from front and rear—and the slain were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Tiande had just been beaten at Jigongliang when Eledengbao pursued through the night. At dawn the rebels stood again; An Lu and Gebushe smashed the line with the left wing and drove them toward Chenghuang Temple, where Yang Yuchun rose from ambush on the right. Caught between the columns, the enemy were cut down without number.

sentences.zh: 又敗王登廷，追至西鄉魚渡壩。

translations.literal: He again defeated Wang Dengting and pursued to Yuduba in Xixiang.
translations.idiomatic: He routed Wang Dengting next and chased him as far as Yuduba in Xixiang.

sentences.zh: 王登明與齊家營股匪合踞青岡嶺，安祿等三路競進，賊大潰，鮮大川、苟文明窺開縣，偕硃射鬥敗之於枯草坡，乘霧奪汪家山，餘賊數千奔下山溝，安祿率五六騎大呼馳擊，賊眾披靡，突林中數矛攢刺，遂歿於陣。

translations.literal: Wang Dengming united with the Qijiaying rebel band and held Qinggangling; An Lu and others advanced in three competing columns and the rebels broke in rout. Xian Dachuan and Gou Wenming watched for an opening at Kaixian; with Zhu Shedou he defeated them at Kucaopo, seized Wangjiashan under cover of fog, and when several thousand remaining rebels fled down a ravine, An Lu led five or six horsemen charging with a great shout; the rebel masses crumpled, but spears thrust out suddenly from the forest and he died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Dengming joined the Qijiaying band on Qinggangling; An Lu and his officers closed in on three routes and shattered them. When Xian Dachuan and Gou Wenming probed Kaixian, An Lu and Zhu Shedou beat them at Kucaopo and took Wangjiashan in the fog. Thousands of fugitives spilled down a ravine; An Lu charged in at the head of five or six riders with a roaring shout and the enemy broke—then spears jabbed out of the woods from every side and he fell.

sentences.zh: 事聞，優恤，賜內帑一千兩，諡壯毅，加予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: When news reached the throne, enhanced posthumous honors were granted, one thousand taels from the privy purse were given, the posthumous title Zhuangyi was conferred, and an additional hereditary rank as Commandant of Cavalry was granted.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the throne, the court granted enhanced honors, one thousand taels from the privy purse, the posthumous title Zhuangyi, and an additional hereditary rank as Commandant of Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 仁宗深惜之，詔以惠倫、安祿皆名將子，膺五等之封，為莠民所戕，國威大損，戒統兵大臣以滿洲、東三省兵自為一隊，及鋒而用，勿致疏虞。

translations.literal: The Jiaqing Emperor deeply regretted it and issued an edict: Huilun and An Lu were both sons of famous generals who had received fifth-rank ennoblement, yet were slain by riffraff—greatly damaging national prestige. Commanders were admonished to keep Manchu and Three Eastern Provinces troops as a separate unit and deploy them at the spearhead; care must be taken against negligence.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor deeply lamented the loss. In an edict he noted that Huilun and An Lu were both sons of celebrated generals ennobled in the fifth rank, yet common ruffians had killed them—an affront that diminished the empire's prestige. Field commanders were warned to keep Manchu and Northeastern troops in a separate column, committed at the point of attack, and never to let their guard slip.

sentences.zh: 子恩特賀莫札拉芬，襲公爵，兼騎都尉。

translations.literal: His son Entehemozhalafen inherited the dukedom and also held the rank of Commandant of Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: His son Entehemozhalafen inherited the ducal title together with the rank of Commandant of Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 尋議又加騎都尉，並為三等輕車都尉，以安祿弟安成襲。

translations.literal: Soon thereafter it was further decided to add a Commandant of Cavalry, combining them as Third-class Commandant of Light Chariots, which An Lu's younger brother Ancheng inherited.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward the court added another Commandant of Cavalry, combining the honors into the rank of Third-class Commandant of Light Chariots, which An Lu's younger brother Ancheng inherited.

sentences.zh: 佛住，瓜爾佳氏，滿洲正白旗人，侍郎三泰子。

translations.literal: Fozhu, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner and son of Vice Minister Santai.
translations.idiomatic: Fozhu, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner and the son of Vice Minister Santai.

sentences.zh: 三泰殉難葉爾羌，封三等伯，佛住襲爵，為散秩大臣、世管佐領，充阿克蘇領隊大臣，授成都副都統。

translations.literal: Santai died at his post at Yarkand and was ennobled as a third-class earl; Fozhu inherited the title, served as a minister of rank without portfolio and hereditary company commander, filled the post of commanding officer at Aksu, and was appointed deputy lieutenant-general at Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: When Santai fell at Yarkand he was ennobled as a third-class earl; Fozhu inherited the title, served as an honorary minister and hereditary company commander, held the Aksu command, and was appointed deputy lieutenant-general at Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，充哈密辦事大臣，行抵西安，聞達州教匪起，自請偕英善往剿，允之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he was appointed commissioner at Hami; reaching Xi'an en route, he heard that sect rebels had risen at Dazhou and volunteered to go with Yingshan to suppress them, which was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 1, while en route to his posting as commissioner at Hami, he reached Xi'an and learned that sect rebels had risen at Dazhou. He volunteered to join Yingshan in suppressing them, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 時賊撲東山廟，與豐城賊合，佛住與副都統勒禮善分路進攻，冒雪由山路破賊卡，扼東山隘口。

translations.literal: At that time the rebels attacked Dongshan Temple and united with the Fengcheng rebels; Fozhu and Deputy Lieutenant-General Le Lishan advanced by separate routes, broke rebel stockades through mountain paths in the snow, and seized the pass at Dongshan.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels were pressing Dongshan Temple and had joined forces with the Fengcheng band. Fozhu and Deputy Lieutenant-General Le Lishan attacked on separate routes, stormed rebel barriers along snowy mountain tracks, and seized the Dongshan pass.

sentences.zh: 賊自大東林潛渡河，率協領塔克慎、知縣劉清隔岸砲擊之。

translations.literal: The rebels secretly crossed the river at Dadonglin; leading Assistant Commandant Takezhen and Magistrate Liu Qing, he shelled them from the opposite bank.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels stole across the river at Dadonglin, he led Assistant Commandant Takezhen and Magistrate Liu Qing in shelling them from the far bank.

sentences.zh: 又偕英善、勒禮善擒徐天富，被優賚。

translations.literal: Again, with Yingshan and Le Lishan he captured Xu Tianfu and received preferential reward.
translations.idiomatic: With Yingshan and Le Lishan he captured Xu Tianfu and was singled out for reward.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，豐城賊傾巢出，游擊範楙、守備楊成陣亡，賊遂逼東鄉，別賊復自張家觀來犯，佛住率眾力戰，歿於陣。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year the Fengcheng rebels came out in full force; Guerrilla Colonel Fan Mu and Battalion Defense Commander Yang Cheng died in battle, and the rebels pressed toward Dongxiang. Another rebel band again attacked from Zhangjiaguan; Fozhu led his men in fierce fighting and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Jiaqing 2 the Fengcheng rebels poured out in force. Guerrilla Colonel Fan Mu and Battalion Defense Commander Yang Cheng fell, and the enemy pressed Dongxiang while another column struck from Zhangjiaguan. Fozhu led a desperate fight and was killed.

sentences.zh: 詔：「佛住已調哈密，自請回川勦賊。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Fozhu had already been transferred to Hami but volunteered to return to Sichuan to suppress rebels.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Fozhu had already been assigned to Hami when he volunteered to return to Sichuan to fight the rebels.

sentences.zh: 今在東鄉捐軀，其父三泰亦係陣亡，尤為可憫，從優議卹。

translations.literal: Now he has given his life at Dongxiang; his father Santai also died in battle—this is especially pitiable; enhanced posthumous honors are granted."
translations.idiomatic: He has now laid down his life at Dongxiang; his father Santai likewise fell in battle—a double grief especially to be mourned. Enhanced posthumous honors are granted."

sentences.zh: 應給世職，並為一等子爵，加一雲騎尉。

translations.literal: The hereditary office due him shall be granted, combined as a first-class viscount, with the addition of one Commandant of Cloud Cavalry."
translations.idiomatic: The hereditary rank due him shall be granted, consolidated as a first-class viscount, with an additional Commandant of Cloud Cavalry."

sentences.zh: 」子瑞齡襲。

translations.literal: His son Ruiling inherited.
translations.idiomatic: His son Ruiling inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 西津泰，和色里氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Xijin Tai, of the Heseli clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Xijin Tai, of the Heseli clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 前鋒侍衛。

translations.literal: A Vanguard Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He served as a Vanguard Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 從征台灣，累戰皆捷，賜號法爾沙台巴圖魯，圖像紫光閣，擢護軍參領。

translations.literal: Campaigning in Taiwan, he was victorious in battle after battle, was granted the title Fa'ershatai Baturu, had his portrait placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor, and was promoted to regimental adjutant of the Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On the Taiwan campaign he won battle after battle, received the title Fa'ershatai Baturu, was honored with a portrait in the Hall of Purple Splendor, and was promoted to regimental adjutant of the Guard.

sentences.zh: 從征苗疆，克榔木陀山、大坪山、雷公灘、大烏草河，圍高多寨，复連破賊於大坡腦、得胜山，克垂藤、董羅諸寨，焚大小天星寨，進克馬鞍山，擢頭等侍衛，加副都統銜。

translations.literal: Campaigning in the Miao frontier, he captured Langmutuo Mountain, Daping Mountain, Leigongtan, and Dawucao River, besieged Gaoduo Stockade, again defeated rebels in succession at Daponao and Desheng Mountain, captured Chuiteng, Dongluo, and other stockades, burned the Great and Small Tianxing stockades, advanced and captured Ma'anshan, was promoted to First-Class Bodyguard, and given the rank of deputy lieutenant-general.
translations.idiomatic: On the Miao frontier he took Langmutuo Mountain, Daping Mountain, Leigongtan, and Dawucao River, invested Gaoduo Stockade, routed rebels at Daponao and Desheng Mountain, stormed Chuiteng, Dongluo, and other strongholds, burned the Great and Small Tianxing stockades, and seized Ma'anshan. He was promoted to First-Class Bodyguard and given deputy lieutenant-general rank.

sentences.zh: 從額勒登保克石隆賊巢，石柳鄧就殲，予優敘。

translations.literal: Following Eledengbao he captured the rebel nest at Shilong; Shi Liudeng was thereupon destroyed, and he received preferential promotion.
translations.idiomatic: With Eledengbao he destroyed the rebel stronghold at Shilong and wiped out Shi Liudeng, earning preferential promotion.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，赴四川，破王三槐於冉家埡、金瓘寺，從宜綿擊賊於花潭子，又克香爐坪賊巢，迭被優賚。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing he went to Sichuan, defeated Wang Sanhuai at Ranjia Pass and Jinguan Temple, followed Yi Mian in attacking rebels at Huatanzi, and again captured the rebel nest at Xiangluping—repeatedly receiving preferential reward.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 2 he went to Sichuan, broke Wang Sanhuai at Ranjia Pass and Jinguan Temple, fought with Yi Mian at Huatanzi, and took the rebel lair at Xiangluping, winning reward after reward.

sentences.zh: 進擊安子坪，賊退精忠寺，圍之，傾巢出犯，西津泰衝入賊陣，手刃十餘賊，身受重創，陣亡。

translations.literal: Advancing against Anziping, the rebels withdrew to Jingzhong Temple; besieging them, the rebels came out in full force to attack. Xijin Tai charged into the rebel formation, personally killed more than ten rebels, suffered grave wounds, and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing Anziping, he drove the rebels back to Jingzhong Temple and invested the place. When they sallied in full force, Xijin Tai drove straight into their ranks, killed more than ten with his own blade, took grave wounds, and fell.

sentences.zh: 予騎都尉兼雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: A hereditary rank as Commandant of Cavalry together with Commandant of Cloud Cavalry was granted.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted hereditary ranks as Commandant of Cavalry and Commandant of Cloud Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 豐伸布，唐古忒氏，蒙古鑲紅旗人，福州駐防。

translations.literal: Feng Shenbu, of the Tangut clan, was a Mongol of the Bordered Red Banner garrisoned at Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Shenbu, of the Tangut clan, was a Mongol of the Bordered Red Banner stationed at Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 由馬甲累擢協領。

translations.literal: From armored cavalryman he was repeatedly promoted to regiment commander.
translations.idiomatic: Starting as an armored cavalryman, he rose by stages to regiment commander.

sentences.zh: 從征台灣，擢西安右翼副都統。

translations.literal: Campaigning in Taiwan, he was promoted to deputy lieutenant-general of the Right Wing at Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the Taiwan campaign he was promoted to deputy lieutenant-general of the Right Wing at Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，率軍駐興安，防湖北教匪。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he led troops to garrison at Xing'an to guard against Hubei sect rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 1 he took troops to Xing'an to block Hubei sect rebels.

sentences.zh: 二年，移防商、雒要隘。

translations.literal: In the second year he shifted his defense to the key passes at Shang and Luo.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 2 he moved to guard the strategic passes at Shangzhou and Luonan.

sentences.zh: 賊犯雙樹卡，又間道攻縣城，連卻之，賞花翎。

translations.literal: Rebels attacked Shuangshuka and also tried by a hidden route to assault the county seat; he repulsed them repeatedly and was awarded a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: When rebels hit Shuangshuka and tried a back route against the county seat, he drove them back again and again and received a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 進駐竹谿，遏賊入陝。

translations.literal: Advancing to garrison Zhuxi, he blocked rebels from entering Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Posted forward to Zhuxi, he blocked rebel incursions into Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 賊掠近地，屢擊走。

translations.literal: Rebels raided nearby areas; he repeatedly attacked and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly beat back rebels raiding the surrounding districts.

sentences.zh: 高天升大股踞石槽溝，率兵千自竹山進剿。

translations.literal: Gao Tiansheng with a large rebel force held Shicaogou; he led a thousand men from Zhushan to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Tiansheng held Shicaogou with a large band; Feng Shenbu led a thousand men out from Zhushan to destroy them.

sentences.zh: 關廟河，要隘也，冒雨進扼之，賊來爭，豐伸布先據山梁，賊分兩路猛撲，殺傷相當，而賊益坌集，短兵相接，豐伸布受創甚，至暮大雨，息軍山巔，以傷殞。

translations.literal: Guanmiao River was a vital pass; advancing through rain to seize it, he contested the ground with the rebels. Feng Shenbu first held the mountain ridge; the rebels divided into two routes and rushed fiercely forward. Casualties were roughly equal, but the rebels gathered in ever greater numbers and closed for hand-to-hand combat. Feng Shenbu was severely wounded; at dusk a great rain fell, the army rested on the mountaintop, and he died of his wounds.
translations.idiomatic: Guanmiao River was the key ground. He pushed through rain to seize it, took the ridge first, and met a two-pronged rebel rush. The fighting was even for a time, but the enemy kept pouring in until the battle came to blades at close quarters. Feng Shenbu was badly wounded; at dusk a downpour halted the fight on the heights, and he died of his wounds.

sentences.zh: 優恤，諡壯勇，予騎都尉兼雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: Enhanced posthumous honors were granted, the posthumous title Zhuangyong was conferred, and hereditary ranks as Commandant of Cavalry and Commandant of Cloud Cavalry were granted.
translations.idiomatic: The court granted enhanced posthumous honors, the posthumous title Zhuangyong, and hereditary ranks as Commandant of Cavalry and Commandant of Cloud Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 六年，高天升就擒，傳首祭墓。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Gao Tiansheng was captured; his head was sent to be offered at the tomb.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 6 Gao Tiansheng was taken; his head was sent to be offered at Feng Shenbu's grave.

sentences.zh: 無子，以侄阿克當阿襲職。

translations.literal: Having no son, his nephew Akedang'a inherited the office.
translations.idiomatic: He left no son; his nephew Akedang'a inherited the rank.

sentences.zh: 阿爾薩朗，賴奇忒氏，蒙古鑲白旗人。

translations.literal: Arsalang, of the Laiqite clan, was a Mongol of the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Arsalang, of the Laiqite clan, was a Mongol bannerman of the Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 以副前鋒參領從征金川，迭克山寨堅碉，破扎古功尤著。

translations.literal: As deputy vanguard regimental adjutant he campaigned in Jinchuan, repeatedly captured mountain stockades and stubborn blockhouses, and was especially distinguished at Zhagugong.
translations.idiomatic: As deputy vanguard regimental adjutant on the Jinchuan campaign, he repeatedly stormed mountain stockades and fortified blockhouses, with particular distinction at Zhagugong.

sentences.zh: 戰達撒谷受創，特詔慰問。

translations.literal: Wounded in battle at Dasagu, he received a special imperial edict of inquiry and consolation.
translations.idiomatic: Wounded fighting at Dasagu, he received a special imperial message of inquiry and consolation.

sentences.zh: 累擢正紅旗蒙古副都統，賜號阿爾杭阿巴圖魯。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to deputy lieutenant-general of the Mongol Plain Red Banner and granted the honorific title Arhang'a Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to deputy lieutenant-general of the Mongol Plain Red Banner and received the honorific title Arhang'a Baturu.

sentences.zh: 金川平，圖像紫光閣。

translations.literal: When Jinchuan was pacified, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: After the pacification of Jinchuan his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 歷喀什噶爾、伊犁領隊大臣，召回京，會甘肅石峰堡回叛，自請從剿，連破賊於雲霧山、田家山，進圍石峰堡，攻其西北，以火攻克之，斬虜特多，授護軍統領，調正藍旗滿洲副都統。

translations.literal: He served successively as commanding officer at Kashgar and Ili; recalled to the capital, when Hui rebels rose at Shifeng Fortress in Gansu he volunteered to join the campaign, repeatedly defeated rebels at Yunwu Mountain and Tianjiashan, advanced to besiege Shifeng Fortress, attacked its northwest corner, took it by fire attack, killed and captured in exceptionally great numbers, was appointed commander of the Guard, and was transferred to deputy lieutenant-general of the Manchu Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He served as commanding officer at Kashgar and Ili in turn, then was recalled to the capital. When Hui rebels rose at Shifeng Fortress in Gansu he volunteered for the campaign, routed them at Yunwu Mountain and Tianjiashan, besieged Shifeng Fortress, stormed the northwest corner by fire attack, and killed or captured a great many. He was appointed commander of the Guard and transferred to deputy lieutenant-general of the Manchu Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，率健銳、火器營從永保剿教匪，轉戰河南、湖北，屢破賊。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he led the Vanguard and Firearms brigades under Yongbao to suppress the sect rebels, fought in Henan and Hubei, and repeatedly defeated the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 1 he led Vanguard and Firearms brigade troops under Yongbao against the sect rebels, campaigning through Henan and Hubei with repeated victories.

sentences.zh: 二年五月，駐兵王家坪，營壘未定，賊自山溝出襲，阿爾薩朗力戰，猝中槍，歿於陣。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year he was stationed at Wangjiaping; before the camp fortifications were complete, rebels rushed out from a mountain ravine to attack; Ersang fought fiercely, was suddenly struck by a musket ball, and died on the field.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Jiaqing 2 he was encamped at Wangjiaping. Before the fortifications were finished, rebels burst from a ravine. Ersang fought hard, took a musket ball, and died on the field.

sentences.zh: 賜卹，予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: Condolence was granted and a hereditary Cavalry Commandant's post awarded.
translations.idiomatic: The court granted condolence and a hereditary Cavalry Commandant's rank.

sentences.zh: 及高天升傳首京師，命祭其墓。

translations.literal: When Gao Tiansheng's head was sent to the capital, an order was issued to offer sacrifice at Ersang's tomb.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Tiansheng's head reached the capital, the court ordered sacrifices at Ersang's grave.

sentences.zh: 烏什哈達，伊爾根覺羅氏，滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Wushihada, of the Irgen Gioro clan, was a Bannerman of the Plain Yellow Banner in Manchuria.
translations.idiomatic: Wushihada, of the Irgen Gioro clan, was a Plain Yellow Banner Manchu.

sentences.zh: 以前鋒從征緬甸有功，賜號法福哩巴圖魯，授三等侍衛。

translations.literal: As a vanguard he campaigned in Burma with merit, was granted the honorific title Fafoli Baturu, and appointed a third-class guardsman.
translations.idiomatic: Serving as a vanguard in Burma, he earned the honorific name Fafoli Baturu and appointment as a third-class guardsman.

sentences.zh: 從征金川，屢克堅碉，擢二等侍衛、正白旗蒙古副都統，予騎都尉加一云騎尉世職。

translations.literal: He campaigned in Jinchuan, repeatedly captured stout blockhouses, was promoted to second-class guardsman and vice commander-in-chief of the Mongol Plain White Banner, and was granted a hereditary Cavalry Commandant with an additional Cloud Cavalry Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In Jinchuan he took one stubborn blockhouse after another, rose to second-class guardsman and vice commander of the Mongol Plain White Banner, and received a hereditary Cavalry Commandant's rank with an additional Cloud Cavalry Commandant's rank.

sentences.zh: 充和闐領隊大臣，坐與辦事大臣德鳳互訐，褫職，效力烏什邊卡。

translations.literal: He served as expedition commander at Khotan; for mutual accusations with the commissioner Defeng he was stripped of office and sent to serve at the Wushi border post.
translations.idiomatic: As expedition commander at Khotan he quarreled with Commissioner Defeng, lost his post, and was sent to serve on the Wushi frontier.

sentences.zh: 尋復起授頭等侍衛、虎槍營營長、健銳營翼長。

translations.literal: Soon he was restored and appointed first-class guardsman, battalion chief of the Tiger Gun Brigade, and wing commander of the Vanguard Camp.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon restored to first-class guardsman, made battalion chief of the Tiger Gun Brigade and wing commander of the Vanguard Camp.

sentences.zh: 從征台灣，率水師擒賊渠莊大田於瑯嶠，复勇號、世職。

translations.literal: He campaigned in Taiwan, led the naval force to capture the rebel chieftain Zhuang Datian at Langqiao, and had his honorific title and hereditary rank restored.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiwan he led the navy to capture the rebel leader Zhuang Datian at Langqiao and had his honorific title and hereditary rank restored.

sentences.zh: 授吉林副都統，調鑲紅旗蒙古副都統。
