translations.literal: He was appointed vice commander-in-chief in Jilin and transferred to vice commander-in-chief of the Mongol Bordered Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was made vice commander in Jilin, then transferred to vice commander of the Mongol Bordered Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 從征廓爾喀，烏什哈達臨陣勇敢，論功輒最，三次圖像紫光閣。

translations.literal: On the Gurkha campaign Wushihada was brave in battle; whenever merit was assessed he ranked first, and his portrait was placed three times in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: On the Gurkha campaign Wushihada fought with conspicuous bravery and invariably ranked first when merits were tallied. His portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor three times.

sentences.zh: 召對，自伐戰績，高宗惡之，褫職戍伊犁。

translations.literal: Summoned to audience, he boasted of his battle achievements; the Gaozong Emperor detested this and stripped him of office, sending him to garrison duty at Ili.
translations.idiomatic: Called to audience, he boasted of his exploits. Emperor Gaozong took offense, stripped him of rank, and banished him to Ili.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，赦歸，請赴湖北軍剿匪自效，偕副都統鄂輝敗賊襄陽，進戰鍾祥。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he was pardoned and returned; he requested to go to the Hubei army to suppress rebels and prove himself, and with Vice Commander Ehui defeated rebels at Xiangyang and advanced to fight at Zhongxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Pardoned in Jiaqing 1, he asked to join the Hubei campaign to redeem himself. With Vice Commander Ehui he beat the rebels at Xiangyang and fought on at Zhongxiang.

sentences.zh: 二年，駐守宜城西岸，賊窺古河口，擊走之。

translations.literal: In the second year he garrisoned the west bank at Yicheng; rebels watched for a chance at Guhekou and were driven off.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 2 he held the west bank at Yicheng, drove off rebels probing Guhekou.

sentences.zh: 移防四川石砫，攻白岩山，克賊卡。

translations.literal: He shifted defense to Shizhu in Sichuan, attacked Baiyanshan, and captured a rebel stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Shizhu in Sichuan, he attacked Baiyanshan and took a rebel stockade.

sentences.zh: 三年，王三槐由梁山、墊江竄渠口，與白岩山賊潛結，引之渡江。

translations.literal: In the third year Wang Sanhuai fled from Liangshan and Dianjiang to Qukou, secretly joined with the Baiyanshan rebels, and led them across the river.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 3 Wang Sanhuai slipped from Liangshan and Dianjiang to Qukou, secretly coordinated with the Baiyanshan rebels, and guided them across the river.

sentences.zh: 烏什哈達兵少不敵，力戰遇害。

translations.literal: Wushihada had too few troops to match them; he fought fiercely and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Outnumbered, Wushihada fought on until he was killed.

sentences.zh: 予輕車都尉世職，子圖爾弼善襲。

translations.literal: He was granted a hereditary Commandant of Chariots and Cavalry; his son Tuerbishan inherited.
translations.idiomatic: He received a hereditary Commandant of Chariots and Cavalry; his son Tuerbishan inherited.

sentences.zh: 和興額，葛濟勒氏，滿洲鑲白旗人。

translations.literal: Hexinge, of the Gejile clan, was a Bannerman of the Bordered White Banner in Manchuria.
translations.idiomatic: Hexinge, of the Gejile clan, was a Bordered White Banner Manchu.

sentences.zh: 以鳥槍護軍從征緬甸、金川、撒拉爾、石峰堡，賜號佛爾欽巴圖魯，累擢廣州右翼副都統。

translations.literal: As a musket guardsman he campaigned in Burma, Jinchuan, the Salar rebellion, and Shifeng Fortress, was granted the honorific title Fo'erqin Baturu, and was repeatedly promoted to vice commander-in-chief of the Guangzhou Right Wing.
translations.idiomatic: As a musket guardsman he fought in Burma, Jinchuan, the Salar revolt, and at Shifeng Fortress, earned the honorific name Fo'erqin Baturu, and rose to vice commander of the Guangzhou Right Wing.

sentences.zh: 坐事降調，授頭等侍衛，充巴里坤領隊大臣，复授廣州左翼副都統。

translations.literal: For an offense he was demoted and transferred, appointed first-class guardsman, served as expedition commander at Barkol, and was again appointed vice commander-in-chief of the Guangzhou Left Wing.
translations.idiomatic: Demoted for an offense, he was made first-class guardsman, served as expedition commander at Barkol, and was restored as vice commander of the Guangzhou Left Wing.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，仲苗擾及廣西西隆，從總督吉慶赴剿，敗賊於戛雄。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing the Central Miao raided into Xilong in Guangxi; he followed Governor Ji Qing to suppress them and defeated rebels at Jiaxiong.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 2, when Central Miao raiders reached Xilong in Guangxi, he followed Governor Ji Qing and routed them at Jiaxiong.

sentences.zh: 苗屯亞稿，設伏山徑，由深箐繞出夾擊，殲之。

translations.literal: The Miao were encamped at Yagao; he set an ambush on the mountain path, came around through a deep ravine in a pincer attack, and annihilated them.
translations.idiomatic: At the Miao camp at Yagao he ambushed the mountain path, swung around through a deep gorge, and destroyed them in a pincer.

sentences.zh: 進攻那地，西隆肅清。

translations.literal: He advanced to attack Nadi and Xilong was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced on Nadi and cleared Xilong.

sentences.zh: 圍岩場寨，連敗之紅水江、板蜯、板階，解冊亨圍。

translations.literal: He besieged Yanchang Stockade, repeatedly defeated them at Hongshui River, Banmang, and Banjie, and lifted the siege of Ceheng.
translations.idiomatic: He besieged Yanchang Stockade, beat them at Hongshui River, Banmang, and Banjie, and lifted the siege of Ceheng.

sentences.zh: 仲苗平，調甘肅涼州副都統。

translations.literal: When the Central Miao were pacified he was transferred to vice commander-in-chief at Liangzhou in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: After the Central Miao were pacified he was posted as vice commander at Liangzhou in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 五年，赴陝西防剿。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he went to Shaanxi for defense and suppression.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 5 he went to Shaanxi on defensive duty.

sentences.zh: 冉學勝等由辛峪竄出，和興額不能禦，奪勇號、花翎，降為防禦，隨營效力。

translations.literal: Ran Xuesheng and others slipped out from Xinyu; Hexinge could not hold them off; his honorific title and peacock feathers were taken away and he was demoted to garrison defense officer to serve with the army.
translations.idiomatic: When Ran Xuesheng broke out from Xinyu, Hexinge failed to stop them. He lost his honorific title and peacock feathers, was demoted to garrison officer, and served in the ranks.

sentences.zh: 尋破賊沔縣乾溝河，授佐領。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he defeated rebels at Qiangouhe in Mian County and was appointed company adjutant.
translations.idiomatic: He soon routed rebels at Qiangouhe in Mian County and was made company adjutant.

sentences.zh: 六年，樊人傑由黑河西竄，和興額扼之於五丁關，擒斬甚眾，擢協領。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Fan Renjie fled east from Heihe; Hexinge blocked him at Wuding Pass, captured and killed many, and was promoted to assistant commander.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 6, when Fan Renjie broke east from Heihe, Hexinge blocked him at Wuding Pass, killed or captured many, and was promoted to assistant commander.

sentences.zh: 冉學勝屯大壩，偕總兵楊奎猷擊之，和興額先進，遇伏，歿於陣，依副都統例賜卹，予騎都尉兼雲騎尉世職，子福格襲。

translations.literal: Ran Xuesheng was encamped at Daba; with Commander Yang Kuiyou he attacked; Hexinge advanced first, met an ambush, and died on the field; condolence was granted on the scale for a vice commander-in-chief, a hereditary Cavalry Commandant combined with Cloud Cavalry Commandant was awarded, and his son Fuge inherited.
translations.idiomatic: When Ran Xuesheng held Daba, Hexinge attacked with Commander Yang Kuiyou, went in first, walked into an ambush, and died. He received posthumous honors on the vice-commander's scale, a combined hereditary Cavalry and Cloud Cavalry Commandant's rank, and his son Fuge inherited.

sentences.zh: 論曰：教匪之役，首尾十年，國史忠義傳所載副參以下戰歿至四百餘員，其專閫提鎮及羽林宿衛階列一二品者，且二十餘人。

translations.literal: The commentators say: The sect-rebel campaign lasted ten years from beginning to end; the Loyalty and Fidelity section of the national history records more than four hundred officers of deputy-commander rank and below who died in battle, and among provincial commanders, garrison commanders, and guardsmen of the first and second ranks there were more than twenty.
translations.idiomatic: The commentators observe: The sect-rebel war ran a full ten years. The Loyalty and Fidelity annals record more than four hundred officers of deputy-commander rank and below killed in action, and more than twenty provincial commanders, garrison generals, and first- or second-rank guardsmen besides.

sentences.zh: 王文雄、硃射鬥，一時名將；

translations.literal: Wang Wenxiong and Zhu Shedou were famous generals of their day;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Wenxiong and Zhu Shedou were the age's most celebrated commanders;

sentences.zh: 穆克登布、施縉，亦號驍勇；

translations.literal: Mu Kedengbu and Shi Jin were also known as fierce and brave;
translations.idiomatic: Mu Kedengbu and Shi Jin were likewise famed for valor;

sentences.zh: 惠倫、安祿，並貴冑俊才。

translations.literal: Huilun and Anlu were both noble scions and gifted talents.
translations.idiomatic: Huilun and Anlu were both high-born men of outstanding promise.

sentences.zh: 倉猝摧僕，三軍氣熸。

translations.literal: Cut down in the suddenness of events, the spirit of the three armies was extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: Struck down without warning, army morale collapsed.

sentences.zh: 當寧為之震惻，旌卹特示優異；

translations.literal: The throne was deeply shaken and grieved for them, granting banners of honor and condolence with special generosity;
translations.idiomatic: The throne was deeply moved and honored them with posthumous rewards of exceptional generosity;

sentences.zh: 餘雖功過相參，要皆竭忠行間，殞身不顧。

translations.literal: the rest, though merit and fault were mixed, all alike exhausted their loyalty on campaign and gave their lives without regard for themselves.
translations.idiomatic: the others, whatever their mixed records, all gave their utmost loyalty in the field and died without thought for themselves.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼，烈已！

translations.literal: Alas, how fierce their devotion!
translations.idiomatic: Alas—how fiercely they gave their all!

sentences.zh: 當日岩疆悍寇，軍事艱難，蓋可見雲。

translations.literal: The stubborn rebels of the frontier regions and the hardships of military affairs in those days may thus be glimpsed.
translations.idiomatic: From this one can glimpse how fierce the frontier rebels were and how hard the fighting had been.
